jobs.description:
MAÎTRE DE CONFÉRENCES dans le domaine du Génie Civil et des milieux poreux H/F - CDI - IMT Mines Alès

Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr.

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre des Matériaux des Mines Alès (C2MA) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'équipe de recherche : UMR LMGC "Laboratoire de Mécanique et Génie Civil".

En tant que Maître de Conférences de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, vous réalisez des tâches d’enseignement, de recherche et de transfert technologique.

Activités d'enseignement

  • Participer aux activités d’enseignements de l’école du département Génie Civil et Bâtiment Durable (GCBD), dans les filières Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO), Bâtiment et Énergie (BE), et Bâtiment (BAT), sous forme de cours magistraux, travaux dirigés, travaux pratiques, encadrement de projets et tutorat d'étudiants ;

  • Assurer des enseignements dans les domaines du Bâtiment dans sa globalité, calculs de structures mais aussi conception générale du bâtiment ou encore Building Information Modeling (BIM) ;

  • Piloter et encadrer un projet de conception tous corps d’état dans la filière Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO) ;

  • Proposer des sujets de missions recherche et développement et en assurer le suivi pour un équivalent de 2 à 3 missions par an ;

  • Dispenser des enseignements en anglais ou développer des méthodes de pédagogie active ;

  • Participer aux jurys de recrutement des élèves et aux actions de promotion de la formation d’ingénieurs ;

  • Assurer le suivi du parcours ingénieur-architecte en lien avec l’école d’architecture de Montpellier, l’Université de Liège et l’École Polytechnique de Mons.

  • Assurer un volume minimal de 150 heures d'enseignement par an.

Activités de recherche

  • Mener des activités de recherche au sein de l'axe « Milieux divisés » du LMGC ;

  • Renforcer l’interconnexion entre une modélisation numérique thermo-hygro-chémomécanique (THCM) et les expériences de laboratoire ;

  • Développer notamment la partie caractérisation des milieux poreux à travers la détermination de la fraction connectée de la porosité, la fraction segmentée de la porosité, la perméabilité, la diffusivité apparente, le degré de saturation…. ;

  • Mener une recherche sur la compréhension du transport de fluides, de la réactivité chimique et de la mécanique des milieux poreux de divers matériaux en particulier les matériaux de construction (matériaux à matrice cimentaire, matériaux pour l’enveloppe, béton de terre crue…) ;

  • Contribuer à la gestion collective de la plateforme Génie-Civil.

Activités de valorisation et de transfert technologique

  • Rechercher et monter des contrats de recherche avec des partenaires industriels et académiques ainsi que rédiger des dossiers de demande de financements auprès d’organismes publics ou de programmes internationaux ;

  • Assurer l'interface avec le partenaire contractuel, prendre en charge les objectifs scientifiques définis dans le projet, animer une équipe projet et assurer le suivi de son déroulement, ainsi que la communication afférente ;

  • Développer une compréhension du processus d’exploitation commerciale de résultats de recherche afin de contribuer à la coopération entre la recherche académique, la recherche industrielle et les secteurs de production.

  • Réaliser, dans son champ de compétences scientifiques et techniques, des actions destinées à accompagner des entreprises ou l’incubateur de l’école afin de favoriser la création de spin off et le développement d’entreprises technologiques.

Vous trouvez plus d’information sur le descriptif du poste ici :

https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/JNC6keL3fq6E8Fn


Le poste requiert une expérience confirmée en enseignement du génie civil et des milieux poreux, ainsi qu’une aptitude à concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pédagogies innovantes adaptées aux compétences visées. Vous devrez disposer d’une expérience solide en recherche, démontrer votre capacité à développer des collaborations scientifiques, à publier vos travaux et à valoriser les résultats de recherche auprès de partenaires académiques et industriels. La maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique est requise ; une expérience internationale et une capacité à vous intégrer aux projets du LMGC et du C2MA constitueront des atouts.

Les critères d'évaluation sont les suivants :

Diplôme requis : diplôme d’ingénieur ou master en génie civil ou en bâtiment durable, ainsi qu’un doctorat en génie civil ou en sciences des matériaux.

Critères de sélection prévalant pour l’activité d’enseignement :

  • Niveau des enseignements dispensés

  • Importance accordée à l’innovation pédagogique

  • Action et notoriété dans la communauté du domaine

Critères de sélection prévalant pour l’activité de recherche  

  • Reconnaissance nationale et internationale des résultats de recherche obtenus

  • Responsabilités exercées dans le domaine d’expertise

  • Relations avec les mondes académique et industriel

L’exercice de responsabilités, les activités d’organisation et la participation à des instances de concertation et de décision entrent également en compte dans les critères examinés.

Modalités de candidature

Le dossier de candidature est à télécharger sur ce lien : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/DT9ZZPFPNpHm5HD

Il est à compléter en français uniquement si vous remplissez les conditions indiquées ci-dessus.

Il est accompagné, notamment, d’un curriculum vitae, d’une lettre de motivation, d’éventuelles lettres de recommandation ainsi que d’une copie de votre carte d’identité, de vos diplômes et de toute attestation de formation ou de stage.

Planning du recrutement

Date limite de clôture des candidatures : 05/11/2026

Date indicative du comité de pré-sélection (pas de présence des candidats) : 23/11/2026. Les candidats admissibles seront informés dans les meilleurs délais après cette date.

Date indicative du comité de recrutement (audition des candidats admissibles en présentiel à l’IMT Mines Alès) : 10/12/2026

Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 01/02/2027

Personnes à contacter

  • Sur les aspects enseignement/recherche :

Jean-Claude SOUCHE, Responsable du département GCBD,

Gwenn LE SAOUT, Référent auprès de l’unité mixte LMGC, Anne BERGERET, Professeur, directrice du C2MA,

  • Sur les aspects administratifs :

Géraldine BRUNEL, Directrice des relations humaines,

Informations complémentaires :

Le recrutement est ouvert dans la discipline "Génie Civil".

Le poste proposé par l’IMT Mines Alès est un contrat à durée indéterminée, à temps plein, contrat de droit public relevant des dispositions du cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, métier C, Maître de conférences, catégorie II.

Ce poste est ouvert à toutes et tous. L’IMT Mines Alès s’engage à mettre en place les aménagements nécessaires pour les personnes en situation de handicap, afin de garantir un environnement de travail inclusif et accessible. 

Rejoignez nous et profitez de ces nombreux avantages :

  • Possibilité de télétravail

  • Nombreux congés

  • Restauration sur place

  • Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75%

  • Forfait mobilité durable pour le covoiturage ou les trajets en vélo

  • Large gamme de prestations sociales

  • Écosystème d'innovation stimulant (startups, étudiants, recherche, entreprises ...)

jobs.description:
Senior DevSecOps Engineer

Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time.

360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue.

We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for.

“Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach.


Within 1 month, you will:

  • Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture

  • Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer

  • Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily

  • Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end


Within 3 months, you will:

  • Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end

  • Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production

  • Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up


Within 6 months, you will:

  • Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts

  • Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention

  • Run infrastructure vulnerability remediation on a predictable cycle with SLA reporting


Within 12 months, you will:

  • Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks

  • Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope

  • Have eliminated long lived credentials on the critical paths, so engineering teams ship on secure defaults they did not have to think about


The Skill Set:

  • 5+ years in infrastructure, cloud or platform engineering with a strong security focus, or in security engineering with hands on infrastructure practice

  • Production experience with Kubernetes: RBAC, network policies, admission controllers, secrets handling, workload identity, runtime security

  • Solid cloud experience, ideally Azure. Strong AWS or Google Cloud experience with a genuine interest in converting works too

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines

  • Scripting and automation: Python or Go, plus shell. Comfortable reading and writing code, and opening pull requests on repositories owned by other teams

  • Log analysis and investigation: cloud audit logs, query languages, correlation across identity, network and application sources

  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR). 

  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L


What we offer:

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈

  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠

Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

Interview Process:

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Marketing Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Marketing Data Scientist

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to support ElevenLabs' offline media and strategic marketing bets: from OOH billboards to niche sponsorships and experimental brand campaigns. You'll build the frameworks that tell us whether a channel with no click to track is actually working, partnering closely with Marketing and the Growth Data team.

  • Design and run measurement for offline / out-of-home campaigns: geo holdout tests, matched-market tests, media mix modelling and incrementality studies.

  • Partner directly with Marketing leadership on which niche channels, markets or formats to test next, and size the bet.

  • Build models that combine offline spend data with digital and product signals into one coherent view of marketing effectiveness.

  • Work alongside the Growth Data team's digital marketing data scientists to keep offline and online measurement consistent.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience measuring marketing effectiveness, ideally including offline, brand or hard-to-track channels (OOH, TV, podcast, sponsorship, events).

  • Strong SQL and Python, with experience in causal inference, media mix modelling or incrementality testing.

  • Comfort designing measurement without a clean click-level signal, and communicating uncertainty honestly.

  • Strong stakeholder management with Marketing / Brand leadership, able to turn a strategic question into a testable plan.

  • Structured thinker comfortable with ambiguity: this is a newer, less-defined function.

Bonus:

  • Experience specifically with OOH, billboard or experiential campaign measurement.

  • Experience with media mix modelling tools or frameworks (Robyn, Recast, LightweightMMM or similar).

  • Experience partnering with brand or creative teams on niche or unconventional marketing bets.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in CET / ET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin or New York.

jobs.title: Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead
jobs.description:
Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead
Your Impact

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead to own the technical development, integration, and lifecycle management of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform environment.
The role covers Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, and Dynamics 365 Marketing, together with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, platform integrations, and related Azure services.
You will translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and determine when to use standard platform capabilities, configuration, low-code development, or custom code. The role combines hands-on platform development with technical leadership, solution governance, and long-term ownership.
This is primarily a Dynamics 365 and Power Platform role. Strong professional software development experience with C#/.NET, React, and TypeScript is a valuable asset where requirements justify custom extensions, components, services, or integrations.
You will work closely with business process owners across customer-facing teams, Technical Customer Support, Marketing, Data Engineering, and Corporate IT.
 
Your Contribution:

  • Own the platform: Set the technical direction for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, including architecture, environments, standards, and lifecycle management.
  • Deliver solutions: Design, configure, develop, test, deploy, and maintain solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
  • Extend where needed: Develop Dataverse plug-ins, custom APIs, business logic, client-side extensions, and Power Apps Component Framework components when standard or low-code capabilities are insufficient.
  • Integrate enterprise systems: Design and maintain secure, reliable integrations between Dynamics 365, ERP, Microsoft 365, Azure, and other business systems.
  • Ensure engineering quality: Establish appropriate practices for source control, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, documentation, security, and technical debt management.
  • Lead technical delivery: Translate business requirements into sound solution designs, guide implementation partners, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure delivered solutions meet agreed standards.


Role Boundaries and Collaboration

The Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead is accountable for:

  • Technical architecture and solution design across Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
  • Dataverse application models, business logic, security configuration, and extensions.
  • Platform integrations, environments, releases, and application lifecycle management.
  • Technical standards, solution quality, and coordination of technical delivery.
Business process owners are accountable for:
  • Business processes, priorities, and functional requirements.
  • Business policies and decision-making.
  • User adoption and expected business outcomes.
  • Acceptance of process and solution changes.
Data Engineering is accountable for:
  • Microsoft Fabric lakehouses and data pipelines.
  • Analytical data models and governed data products.
  • Power BI platform delivery and analytical reporting.
These roles collaborate on data contracts, data quality, lineage, security, and the reliable transfer of Dynamics 365 data into the analytical data platform.


Your Background

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions, ideally including Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Dataverse, including data models, security roles, business logic, solutions, environments, and model-driven applications.
  • Practical experience with Power Apps and Power Automate beyond basic configuration or citizen-development scenarios.
  • Experience extending Dynamics 365 and Dataverse using C# plug-ins, custom APIs, and JavaScript/TypeScript client-side extensions.
  • Experience with REST/OData, the Dataverse Web API, authentication, error handling, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Practical experience with Power Platform ALM, Git-based source control, CI/CD, testing, and controlled deployment across environments.
  • Sound understanding of enterprise application security, reliability, maintainability, and supportability.
  • Ability to translate business workflows into pragmatic technical solutions and make sound trade-offs between standard functionality, low-code development, and custom code.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance, review solution designs and code, and work effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland
Strong plus / nice-to-have
  • Professional software development experience with C#/.NET, including production applications, backend services, APIs, or integration components.
  • Experience with React and TypeScript, particularly for custom user experiences or Power Apps Component Framework components.
  • Experience designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining custom software beyond Dynamics 365 and low-code solutions.
  • Experience with Azure integration services such as Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
  • Practical experience with Dynamics 365 Marketing (Customer Insights – Journeys).
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Power BI sufficient to collaborate effectively on data integration and reporting requirements.
  • Experience with Power Platform governance or enterprise-scale environment and solution management.
  • Familiarity with Copilot Studio or AI-enabled capabilities within Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400), or comparable Microsoft Learn training supported by relevant practical experience.
Working style and profile
  • Combines deep Dynamics 365 and Power Platform expertise with pragmatic software engineering judgment.
  • Takes hands-on ownership while providing clear technical direction and standards.
  • Prefers maintainable, standard-first solutions and uses customization deliberately where it creates clear value.
  • Balances delivery speed with security, reliability, supportability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Communicates technical trade-offs clearly and builds alignment across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Works collaboratively, challenges unnecessary complexity constructively, and takes responsibility through the full solution lifecycle.


What We Offer

  • Work with a team of experienced IT professionals using modern hybrid cloud infrastructure.
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing internal and external training.
  • Attractive vacation entitlement.
  • Flexible working arrangements with home office allowance.
  • Comprehensive pension plans that reflect individual seniority.
  • Contributions to public transportation.
  • Regular team events.
  • FELFEL with healthy food and beverages.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

For the Project Manager level

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.title: AI Consultant (all genders) - Hybrid, Berlin/Frankfurt
jobs.description:
AI Consultant (all genders) - Hybrid, Berlin/Frankfurt
Your mission

Bringing ML research into application

dida builds custom machine learning software for industrial and enterprise clients, among them Siemens, Deutsche Bahn, idealo, klöckner.i and Enpal, and has received the Microsoft “AI for Earth Award” for innovative environmental projects, among other recognitions. Our team combines scientific excellence with real business requirements.

Many of our projects start with a concept or evaluation workshop: together with the decision makers we assess use cases and the data situation and turn vague ideas into a concrete project roadmap. We are currently building this workshop format into a consulting offering of its own, and we are looking for reinforcement.

Your role: strategic and technical consulting

As an AI Consultant you are the bridge between our ML scientists and the business units of our clients. You work in tandem with the Account Management and Business Development team and take the technical lead in workshops and pre-sales meetings.

In this position you are the face of dida for specific industries: you follow no rigid process, but develop innovative solutions together with our engineers and our clients.

Your tasks

  • Prepare and run workshops: You prepare client workshops and run them together with the team. Your part is the technical depth: assessing use cases, reviewing the data situation, judging feasibility and translating complex ML concepts into clear business cases.
  • Turn results into roadmaps: You translate workshop results into technical roadmaps and work with our ML teams on effort estimates and proposal content.
  • Work hands-on: You look at client data yourself and build clickable prototypes and small demos that make workshop results tangible right away.
  • Support business development: You bring in technical expertise, for example in discovery calls or on feasibility questions. Commercial responsibility for accounts, offers, pricing and negotiations stays with the sales team.
  • Develop our standards: You extend our workshop frameworks and templates that we reuse with every new client.


Your Profile

  • Education: A strong degree in a quantitative field, for example data science, computer science, mathematics, physics or engineering.
  • Consulting experience: Ideally 2 to 5 years. Big firm or boutique matters less than having worked on projects directly at the client. Exposure to several industries is a plus.
  • Data science and coding: You understand how ML models work and know your way around databases. Practical data science experience and solid coding skills, above all in Python, are a plus.
  • Hands-on mentality: You try things out directly and enjoy building a first prototype quickly.
  • Presence with clients: You enjoy standing in front of clients, moderate discussions confidently and explain technical content in a way that both the business side and IT understand.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German for the DACH market and fluent English for our internal communication.
  • Teamwork: You like working closely with others. Sharing knowledge and giving direct feedback are part of the job for you.

Even if you do not tick every box: we look forward to your application.


Why us?

  • Building something: You help build a young consulting offering from the start and see the effect of your work directly at the client.
  • Team: Close to 40 people from different disciplines with a strong mathematics and physics background, many of them with a PhD.
  • Flexibility: Flexible hours and hybrid work, full-time or part-time.
  • Office: A nice office with good coffee in Berlin-Kreuzberg near Moritzplatz, and in the future in Frankfurt.
  • Short paths: Direct collaboration with the management team.
  • Location: Berlin. Frankfurt am Main is possible by arrangement, many of our clients are based in southern and south-western Germany.


What we need from you?

Please include with your application:

  • CV (required)
  • Degree certificates (required)
  • Transcripts of records, if available
  • Project or code samples (optional)

jobs.title: Senior Sales Director, EMEA
Senior Revenue Ops
jobs.description:
Senior Revenue Ops

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

#LI-DNP

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille or Annecy.

Marketing Operations

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Senior Full Stack Engineer
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver.


The Role

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow.


You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 


Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span:

  • Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads.

  • Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own.

  • Production Acceleration: Finding the bottlenecks between CAD/CAM data submission and shipped parts.

  • Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal.


Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems.


What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years as a software engineer with proven experience in shipping code to production, across backend and frontend

  • Broad Technical Range: Experience in systems design, architecture and implementation. In general, you don’t shy away from new technologies and pick up whatever the problem requires. Our current tech stack is: Rust, PostgreSQL, React,  Python, AWS.

  • End-to-End Ownership: From talking to the user, to schema, to API, to UI, to rollout. You don't hand off "the other half."

  • Industrial Grit: Comfortable spending time on the shop floor in Germany to understand how work actually happens and how your software interacts with precision machinery.

  • Autonomy: You are comfortable with diving into new topics, coming up with solutions and driving their implementation

  • Bonus points: Knowledge of manufacturing and how factories operate, basic understanding of the Manufacturing Automation Pyramid

  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.

Associate Director, Transportation UK & EU
About the Company
 
e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face. 
 
Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.
 
In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands. 
 
Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 
 
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us

 

Position Summary

The Associate Director, Transportation for the UK & EU is accountable for the performance, cost, and future-readiness of our regional transportation network. This role owns the day-to-day service levels our retail partners and consumers expect, while continuously reviewing and challenging the cost base, and — critically — developing the strategy that ensures our 3PL and carrier capacity can absorb the rapid growth ahead.

Sitting in London and reporting to the US-based Associate Director of Transportation, you will be the regional leader who bridges global strategy with local execution. You will partner closely with our 3PL providers, internal commercial and supply chain teams, and the US transportation function to deliver a network that is reliable, cost-efficient, scalable, and aligned to e.l.f.'s values.

Responsibilities:

Service Level Management

· Own end-to-end transportation service performance across the UK and EU, including on-time delivery, order fulfillment accuracy, and transit-time reliability for retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

· Define, track, and publish transportation KPIs and SLAs; lead monthly and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with 3PL and carrier partners to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

· Serve as the primary escalation point for transportation service failures; root-cause issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.

· Ensure transportation execution meets the requirements of key retail partners (e.g., compliance with retailer routing guides, delivery windows, and ASN/labeling standards).

Cost Review & Optimization

· Own the regional transportation budget and freight spend; forecast, monitor, and explain variances monthly, identifying trends and driving corrective action.

· Conduct regular cost-to-serve analysis across lanes, modes, and channels; identify and implement opportunities to reduce cost per unit without compromising service.

· Lead carrier rate negotiations, spot-market management, and freight procurement in coordination with the US Director of Transportation and procurement team.

· Evaluate mode and lane optimization, consolidation, and network design changes to deliver year-over-year cost savings.

3PL Capacity & Growth Strategy

· Develop and maintain a forward-looking transportation capacity strategy that aligns with e.l.f.'s aggressive international growth plans, modeling 1-, 3-, and 5-year volume scenarios against 3PL and carrier capability.

· Assess the scalability of existing 3PL partners — across warehousing throughput, outbound capacity, peak-season flex, and geographic coverage — and recommend capacity additions, alternate partners, or network changes ahead of need.

· Lead or support RFPs, partner selection, onboarding, and contract governance for new or expanded 3PL and carrier relationships across the UK and EU.

· Build peak-season and surge-readiness plans in partnership with 3PLs, ensuring capacity, labor, and equipment commitments are secured well in advance of demand spikes (e.g., holiday, promotional events, new-retailer launches).

· Identify and mitigate supply chain risks — carrier concentration, single-lane dependency, customs/border exposure — with documented contingency plans.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Compliance

· Partner with the US Associate Director of Transportation to ensure regional execution aligns with global transportation strategy, systems, and standards (e.g., TMS, visibility platforms, carrier scorecards).

· Collaborate with Supply Planning, Demand Planning and Commercial Operations to align transportation capacity with forecasted demand and product launch timelines.

· Ensure full compliance with UK and EU transportation, customs, and trade regulations, and partner with customs brokers to maintain efficient and compliant cross-border movement.

· Champion e.l.f.'s sustainability commitments in transportation decisions, including modal shift, emissions reduction, and carrier sustainability standards.

Requirements:

· Lead the transportation strategy working with the other operations team professionals, building capability and a culture of continuous improvement.

· Act as the regional transportation subject-matter expert and represent the function in cross-functional initiatives and leadership reviews.

· Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

· 5+ years of progressive experience in transportation, logistics, or 3PL management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience managing 3PL relationships and carrier networks at scale, including SLA governance, QBRs, and performance management.

· Strong financial acumen — proven ownership of a transportation or freight budget, cost-to-serve analysis, and rate negotiation.

· Deep working knowledge of UK and EU transportation markets, carrier landscapes, customs/trade compliance, and retail routing-guide requirements.

· Experience planning capacity or network strategy to support significant volume growth.

jobs.description:
Head of Engineering - Optimisation & Control

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

🚀 What you’ll own:
The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth.

  • Managing the leads.

  • Maintaining the technical vision for a given area.

  • The overall team architecture

  • Ensuring the services in that area are owned and maintained appropriately.

  • Ensuring that product features are built in a way that scales, is cost-effective, and is in line with the vision for a product area.

  • Ensuring the appropriate level of quality and resilience, with a specific focus on reducing system incidents and improving stability.

  • Ensuring appropriate tech debt is prioritised to support sustainable delivery.

  • Potentially managing a squad (team) as well.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:
You’ll be a strong fit if you have experience leading engineering teams across multiple squads, teams or product areas in a complex product environment.

  • A collaborative product and engineering mindset: you care about customer outcomes, product strategy, technical quality and the people needed to make the work real.

  • Strong judgement in ambiguity: you can separate urgent from important, make trade-offs explicit and help teams move without pretending all uncertainty has disappeared.

  • A track record of influencing beyond your reporting line and team, building trust with senior stakeholders and helping teams reach decisions when ownership is shared.

  • A bias for action and improvement: when you see a recurring issue, you turn it into the smallest useful action that starts making the system better.

  • Reliability in driving initiatives: people can trust that when you take ownership, the work keeps moving, dependencies are managed and decisions are followed through.

  • Strong people leadership practice, including coaching, direct feedback, performance management, delegation, psychological safety and development of future leaders.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at ----- We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms

Focus Entertainment Publishing - Communication Director (H/F/Nb)

Le.la Communication Director pilote la stratégie de communication externe globale de Focus Entertainment Publishing et de son portefeuille de titres. Rattaché(e) au Chief Marketing Officer, il ou elle encadre et fait grandir les équipes Social Media, Community Development, PR & Influence en garantissant l'impact, la cohérence et la créativité des campagnes de communication de nos jeux.

Missions Principales

  1. Stratégie de Communication 

  • Co-construire avec les autres directeurs du département Marketing & Créa les plans de communication 360° (RP, social, influence, community) alignés sur les objectifs business et les temps forts des jeux

  • Définir les KPIs clés (reach, engagement, community sentiment, cpv,..), suivre les performances des campagnes et ajuster la stratégie en temps réel sur l'ensemble des canaux (médias, réseaux sociaux, influence).

  • Coordonner les partenariats stratégiques (OEM, marque, VIP, ...) pour maximiser la visibilité croisée des titres.

  • Anticiper et piloter la communication sensible ou de crise (issues management), en lien avec les équipes juridiques, RH et la direction, afin de protéger la réputation de l'entreprise et de ses titres.

2. Leadership & Management des Équipes

  • Encadrer, fédérer et développer équipes Social Media, Community Development, Presse & Influence.

  • Structurer l'organisation des équipes, fixer les priorités, optimiser l'allocation des ressources et insuffler une vision créative et innovante.

  • Porter les enjeux de ses équipes au sein du département Marketing & Créa et auprès des autres directions (Production, LiveOps, Content,..).

3. Relations Presse, Influence & Partenariats

  • Valider et guider les stratégies globales de relations presse et d'influence (campagnes d'ambassadeurs, événements de type preview, activations spéciales).

  • Superviser le travail des agences partenaires en France et à l'international, piloter les budgets et optimiser les outils de suivi.

  • Construire et entretenir un réseau de contacts presse, influenceurs et partenaires à l'échelle internationale.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Logistics Coordinator

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

The Logistics Officer owns the daily inbound and outbound logistics function across Harmattan AI’s two French sites — the Wissous production facility and the Paris engineering office. Reporting to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead, the role operates with significant autonomy: independently managing freight flows, customs compliance, dangerous goods, and international trade requirements without requiring hand-holding on routine decisions.

This is not a pure execution role. The Logistics Officer brings senior operational experience and the judgement to run the function independently day-to-day — escalating where needed, but owning the full logistics picture between escalations. The right candidate has seen enough complexity — military goods, DG shipments, ITAR — to handle it confidently and knows when something requires attention from the Lead.

Responsibilities

Inbound Logistics

  • Own inbound freight flows for both sites — booking, tracking, customs clearance, and goods receipt for components, materials, and equipment

  • Proactively manage supplier and forwarder relationships to resolve delays and protect the Wissous production schedule

  • Process import documentation, verify HS/CN classification, and coordinate with customs brokers to ensure clean clearance

  • Escalate supply disruptions and compliance flags to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead with structured context and a proposed resolution

Outbound Logistics

  • Manage outbound shipments to customers, integrators, programme offices, demonstrations, and trade events — from booking through to proof of delivery

  • Prepare complete export documentation — commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, export declarations, and end-user certificates

  • Manage temporary export regimes and ATA carnets for demonstration and event shipments, including tracking and timely return

  • Independently assess ITAR, EAR, and EU/French dual-use export control requirements for each outbound shipment — applying the correct treatment and flagging licence requirements before despatch

Dangerous Goods

  • Independently classify, prepare, and document dangerous goods shipments under ADR, IATA DGR, and IMDG — lithium batteries (UN 3480/3481), propellants, and other regulated materials

  • Ensure packaging, labelling, marking, and documentation are correct on every DG movement without requiring supervision

  • Monitor freight partner compliance with DG handling standards and raise issues to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead

Customs & Trade Compliance

  • Apply confident working knowledge of HS/CN tariff codes, incoterms, and customs regimes to ensure accurate and complete declarations

  • Maintain full compliance records — export licences, end-user certificates, DG records, and customs documentation — to audit standard

  • Stay current on changes to ITAR, EAR, EU dual-use regulations, and customs procedures relevant to Harmattan AI’s trade lanes

Site Coordination & Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate goods flows between Wissous and Paris, ensuring accurate stock transfers, documentation, and storage standards for military hardware and dangerous goods

  • Identify process gaps, recurring issues, or compliance risks in the logistics function and bring structured improvement proposals to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead

  • Work closely with production, supply chain, and engineering teams to align logistics priorities with operational needs

Candidate Requirements

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in freight, logistics, or supply chain in a regulated industry — defence, aerospace, advanced electronics, or similar

  • Able to operate the inbound/outbound logistics function independently — making sound daily decisions on customs, DG, and compliance without close supervision

  • Solid hands-on knowledge of customs documentation: HS/CN classification, import/export declarations, incoterms, and freight procedures across Europe, the US, and the Middle East

  • Direct working experience with ITAR, EAR, and EU/French dual-use export control regulations applied to physical shipments

  • Certified and experienced in dangerous goods — IATA DGR, ADR, or equivalent — with specific experience on lithium batteries and military-relevant materials

  • Familiarity with military goods logistics: packaging, marking, documentation, and transport standards for defence hardware

  • Detail-oriented, compliance-driven, and calm under time pressure

  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken

Preferred

  • Experience with temporary export regimes, ATA carnets, and trade event logistics

  • Familiarity with ERP or WMS systems (Odoo or equivalent)

  • Experience coordinating logistics across multiple sites

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
