Chargée ou chargé d'affaires réglementaires - CDD 12 Mois

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

Au sein du Centre Ingénierie et Santé et du MedTechLab, vous contribuez au déploiement d’une stratégie technico-réglementaire permettant de sécuriser le développement, l’expérimentation, l’évaluation et, le cas échéant, la mise sur le marché de produits et services innovants en santé, notamment de dispositifs médicaux et de solutions de santé numérique.

Le MedTechLab®, cofondé par Mines Saint-Étienne, AÉSIO Santé et AÉSIO Mutuelle, est un espace d’open innovation dédié à la co-création, la modélisation, le test et l’expérimentation d’innovations pour la santé et l’autonomie. Lauréat de l’appel à projets Tiers Lieux d’Expérimentation de France 2030, il accompagne industriels, start-up et acteurs sanitaires et médico-sociaux dans des études d’usage, études cliniques, analyses médico-économiques, études de marché et démarches allant jusqu’au développement de produits minimum viables.

Vous intervenez en appui des équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, en lien avec les partenaires académiques, hospitaliers et industriels. Vous accompagnez les projets sur leurs différentes étapes : R&D, stratégie réglementaire, recherche clinique, gestion des risques, constitution et maintenance de la documentation technique, marquage CE et suivi post-marquage.

Objectif du poste : garantir la prise en compte des exigences réglementaires et qualité applicables aux projets du MedTechLab et développer une culture partagée des affaires réglementaires au sein de l’écosystème.

Vos missions principales :

• Contrôler la conformité des activités et des processus au regard des référentiels applicables et contribuer à la création et à l’évolution de la documentation des systèmes et outils qualité.

• Dans le cadre du projet PREMYOM, accompagner le comité d’éthique interne du consortium en lien avec les DPO des différents partenaires.

• Identifier les normes et réglementations applicables aux projets de recherche et d’innovation du MedTechLab, assurer une veille réglementaire et normative et coordonner cette veille avec les partenaires.

• Accompagner la mise en œuvre des normes ISO 14155, ISO 13485 et ISO 14971, notamment pour les études cliniques, les systèmes de management de la qualité et l’analyse des risques.

• Accompagner les équipes dans la conformité des recherches cliniques et apporter un appui méthodologique et technique.

• Contribuer aux stratégies de marquage CE : supervision et rédaction des dossiers techniques, déclarations de mise sur le marché, maintien de la documentation de conformité et suivi post-marquage.

• Piloter l’évaluation réglementaire des changements, gérer la liste des normes appliquées aux projets et traiter les questions réglementaires et techniques des autorités de santé à la suite des dépôts de dossiers.

• Dans le cadre du RGPD, veiller, en lien avec les DPO de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’AÉSIO Santé, à la conformité des projets et au respect des procédures.

• Préparer et animer les réunions qualité / affaires réglementaires, contribuer aux comités de pilotage, suivre les indicateurs, élaborer des tableaux de bord et communiquer sur la démarche d’amélioration continue.

• Participer aux réseaux professionnels et entretenir les relations utiles avec les autorités et organismes compétents (ANSM, ANS, CNIL, CPP, CNAM, etc.).

• Définir les stratégies réglementaires des produits (classification, voie de mise sur le marché, marchés cibles : UE, France, puis international)

• Assurer la veille sur les évolutions normatives et réglementaires (MDR 2017/745, IVDR 2017/746, AI Act, RGPD, cybersécurité, données de santé) et en mesurer l'impact

• Anticiper les exigences liées aux innovations (logiciels dispositifs médicaux, IA, objets connectés, etc.)

• Gérer les échanges avec les organismes notifiés

• Sensibiliser et former les équipes internes aux enjeux réglementaires


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation supérieure dans le domaine des affaires réglementaires, de la qualité ou du droit de la santé :

• Licence professionnelle, Master 1 ou Master 2 en affaires réglementaires, droit de la santé, qualité appliquée aux produits de santé ou formation équivalente sont privilégié. Également une première expérience en affaires réglementaires dans le secteur de la santé (dispositifs médicaux, e-santé ou médicament). Profils juniors motivés à étudier selon le contexte.

 

Connaissances recherchées :

• Réglementation des dispositifs médicaux et référentiels associés, notamment règlement (UE) 2017/745 (MDR), ISO 13485, ISO 14155 et ISO 14971.

• Réglementation des recherches cliniques, bonnes pratiques cliniques, RGPD, procédures de recherche clinique, cycle de développement d’un projet innovant en santé, vocabulaire médical et scientifique.

 

Compétences attendues :

• Capacité à identifier et interpréter les exigences réglementaires et normatives applicables à un projet, et à les traduire en actions opérationnelles.

• Maîtrise des méthodes d’analyse des risques, de résolution de problèmes et de gestion documentaire ; capacité à contribuer à des dossiers techniques et de marquage CE.

• Capacité à conduire des projets transversaux, à argumenter des solutions en assurance qualité / affaires réglementaires et à travailler avec des interlocuteurs académiques, cliniques, industriels et institutionnels.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et capacité à élaborer des outils de suivi, indicateurs et tableaux de bord.

• Anglais scientifique écrit ; capacité à échanger en anglais dans un contexte professionnel appréciée.

Qualités personnelles :

• Autonomie, rigueur, organisation, sens des priorités, polyvalence et capacité d’adaptation ; respect du secret professionnel, de l’éthique et de la réglementation en vigueur.

• Curiosité pour l'innovation et capacité à trouver des solutions conformes

• Aisance relationnelle, sens du travail en équipe et capacité à communiquer avec des partenaires variés. Des déplacements ponctuels en France sont à prévoir selon les projets.

Relations professionnelles : médecins investigateurs, TEC, chefs de projets de recherche clinique, biostatisticiens, data-managers, équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, partenaires AÉSIO, structures de recherche clinique et technologique, start-up et industriels, ainsi que les instances administratives et réglementaires compétentes.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

jobs.title: Junior Computational Geometry Engineer
jobs.description:
Junior Computational Geometry Engineer
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Junior Computational Geometry Engineer, you work on the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack: the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model, reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You start on well-scoped parts of that engine, next to the engineers who built it, and grow into owning them. Your code runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • Foundations. Degree in computer science, mathematics, mechanical engineering or a related field, with real depth in geometry, linear algebra and numerics. Internships, thesis work or serious side projects count. We do not expect years of production experience.
  • B-rep Basics. You are comfortable with topology, NURBS, meshes and point clouds. You may never have shipped a robust boolean, and you still understand why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations, and you want to learn how the field handles it.
  • Kernel Exposure. You have worked with a geometry kernel and mesh libraries in at least one project: OpenCASCADE, CGAL, libigl, Open3D, PCL, Parasolid or comparable.
  • Technical Ability. Solid modern C++ (17+) plus Python for tooling and rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write code others can read, test and maintain.
  • Manufacturing Curiosity. You want to understand what happens once geometry meets a spindle, a nozzle or a fixture. CNC, additive or metrology exposure is a bonus, never a requirement.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you dig until you know whether the bug sits in the code, the model or the assumption.
  • Learning Speed. You take direct feedback, apply it immediately, and close your own knowledge gaps without waiting to be taught.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • On-site. Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll help define it.
  • People who treat “it works on the test model” as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich.



Apply

  • Resume: Focus on the geometry work you have actually done. Thesis, internships, projects, coursework.
  • GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hardest problem you have solved. Code, a write-up, or a part that came off a machine because of you.
  • Coverletter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

As a Medtech R&D Domain Expert at REMATIQ, you will work closely with customers, Delivery, Product, and Engineering to drive customer projects, create an understanding how medtech R&D teams work today and help translate these workflows into high-impact AI use cases.

This is not an academic advisory role. You will be hands-on in customer projects, helping structure problems, drive workstreams, create materials, review outputs, and turn domain expertise into practical solutions.

You will:

  • Own and drive customer project workstreams from discovery through workflow design, implementation support, testing, iteration, and delivery.

  • Work directly with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and cross-functional customer teams to understand their product development processes, documentation, constraints, pain points, and opportunities for AI-powered improvement.

  • Bring domain expertise across medtech R&D workflows such as systems engineering, design controls, requirements, risk management, verification & validation, design reviews, design transfer, DHF / technical documentation, and related quality processes — and act as a domain sparring partner for internal teams.

  • Create and review project deliverables such as customer workshop materials, R&D workflow maps, gap analyses, impact assessments, target process designs, use-case specifications, and AI-generated outputs together with customer subject-matter experts.

  • Collect customer learnings and feedback and translate them into structured internal feedback for Product and Engineering.

  • Use AI tools actively to speed up your own work, create high-quality outputs faster, and improve how customer projects are delivered.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who combines medtech R&D domain expertise, strong project ownership, customer-facing communication, and a hands-on execution mindset.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in medtech R&D, product development, innovation, design controls, technical project management, R&D transformation, or a related consulting role.

  • Practical understanding of how medical devices are developed in regulated environments — including topics such as design controls, requirements management, risk management, verification & validation, design reviews, design transfer, DHF / technical documentation, and quality processes — and the ability to translate this into AI-enabled use cases, project deliverables, and structured product feedback.

  • Comfortable with speed and change: REMATIQ is growing extremely fast, with the organization doubling every 9-12 months. You need to be comfortable in a high-speed, high agency environment with rapidly changing scope and roles.

  • AI savviness: you actively use AI tools to improve your own work, move faster, create better deliverables, and explore new ways of working.

  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus for German-speaking customer work.

Why join REMATIQ?

  • Rare timing: Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies at a pivotal stage as we move from Seed toward Series A and prepare to significantly grow the team.

  • Real ownership: Own high-impact customer projects and see your work translate directly into outcomes for leading MedTech and life sciences companies.

  • Unmatched exposure: Work directly with founders, customers, product teams, and technical experts while building a network across the global MedTech and life sciences industry.

  • Purposeful work: Be part of a mission-driven team transforming how medical devices reach the market — in an industry where quality, compliance, and patient safety mean nothing can be left to chance.

  • Compensation & growth: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a stake in the success you help create.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive (EMEA)
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
 
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
 
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
 
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
 
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! 

Role Overview 

Magnet Forensics is seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business growth across the  European (excluding United Kingdom and Ireland) forensic service provider market (EMEA FSP 2)
 
This role is focused on building pipeline, acquiring strategic new enterprise customers, and expanding adoption across corporate and private-sector organisations. The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven ability to independently develop territory strategy, create opportunities, and own complex enterprise sales cycles end-to-end using a MEDDPICC-driven sales approach, in addition to handling high volumes of smaller, transactional type sales which involve a rapidly moving sales cycle.
 
As a key member of Magnet Forensics’ EMEA team, you will operate with significant ownership of the EMEA FSP 2 region, working closely with partners located across Europe, marketing, dedicated sales development representative (SDR), sales engineering, and leadership to establish and scale market presence.
 

This role is best suited to candidates motivated by long-term territory development and market ownership rather than short-term account management or inherited revenue.

Candidate must reside in Germany

What You’ll Do

Sales Execution & Territory Ownership

  • Develop and execute a territory plan focused on pipeline creation, new logo acquisition, and predictable revenue growth across the European forensic service provider market.
  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through commercial negotiation and close.
  • Maintain strong pipeline coverage aligned to quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Engage executive stakeholders and decision makers within enterprise organizations.

    • MEDDPICC Deal Execution

    • Apply MEDDPICC rigorously to qualify opportunities, access economic buyers, build champions, multithread, and drive forecast accuracy.
    • Navigate complex multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environments and long sales cycles.
    • Maintain disciplined opportunity management and forecasting practices.

      • Market Expansion

      • Drive market penetration through outbound prospecting, executive networking, and partner collaboration.
      • Acquire new enterprise logos while expanding strategic existing accounts.
      • Identify and develop growth opportunities within key verticals and regulated industries.

        • Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

      • Work closely with regional partners and resellers to generate pipeline and execute joint sales strategies.
      • Enable partners through joint account planning, opportunity alignment, and customer engagement activities.

        • Marketing & Industry Engagement

        • Collaborate with marketing to support regional campaigns, events, and demand generation initiatives. This will sometimes involve collaborating with partners.
        • Represent Magnet Forensics at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements across Europe.

          • Customer Engagement

          • Act as a trusted advisor to customers by understanding investigative, cybersecurity, and digital forensics challenges.
          • Deliver solution-led sales engagements aligned to customer outcomes and business value.

What We’re Looking For
  • 4+ years of enterprise sales experience within SaaS, Cybersecurity, DFIR, or adjacent technology markets.
  • Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently exceeding revenue targets. Demonstrated ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and executive networking.
  • Experience managing both complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and shorter sales cycles and executive with efficiency and precision.
  • Strong experience applying MEDDPICC (or equivalent) sales methodology.
  • Experience working with both direct and partner-led sales models.
  • Self-starter with the ability to operate independently in a developing region.
  • Comfortable working across international teams and time zones.
  • Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and executive communication skills.
  • Highly organized with disciplined forecasting and pipeline management practices. Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, ownership-driven approach to territory growth.
  • Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
  • Meticulous with a strong eye for administrative detail – certain products sold by the EMEA FSP team have a heavily involved approval process where this trait is a must.
    •  

    What Success Looks Like in This Role
  • Build and develop a sustainable enterprise pipeline across the European forensic service provider market through proactive prospecting, partner engagement, and executive relationship development.
  • Establish Magnet Forensics as a trusted investigative technology partner within strategic enterprise accounts.Consistently progress opportunities through structured discovery, value alignment, and MEDDPICC-driven execution.Deliver predictable revenue performance while contributing to long-term regional market growth.

    •  


    Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: 
     
    - Generous time off policies 
    - Competitive compensation 
    - Volunteer opportunities  
    - Reward and recognition programs   
    - Employee committees & resource groups  
     
    Indicators of Success
     
    We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”.  It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”.  We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. 
     
    How We Work
     
    At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.
     
    We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!
     
    The Most Important Thing
     
    We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:
     
    CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.
    OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.
    DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.
    EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.
     
    Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.
     
    Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact

Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.

Ready to help shape the future of aviation?

Tasks

You'll build and take ownership of specific finance and cost models within our digital twin of the global aviation market, for example giving our clients insights in what it really costs an airline to operate a given aircraft on a given route. Partnerships Lead

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

We're hiring a high-ownership sales operator to drive sourced pipeline and revenue through the Microsoft Azure channel.

This is a quota-carrying, field-facing role. You'll map Microsoft's ISV and enterprise field org, activate co-sell motions with the right PDMs and AEs, and build the repeatable sales plays that move customers to Fireworks AI through Azure Foundry. You'll own the forecast and the number.

The playbook doesn't fully exist yet. You'll have real influence over how we engage Microsoft's field teams, what good looks like for partner-sourced pipeline, and how we build a co-sell motion that scales across ISV and enterprise segments. If you thrive when you're creating from scratch and can hold yourself accountable to a number while doing it, this is the role.

What you'll own

Pipeline and revenue

  • Source and own a pipeline target through the Microsoft Azure channel

  • Co-sell qualified opportunities with Microsoft ISV and enterprise AEs and PDMs

  • Run weekly forecasting cadences with accurate CRM hygiene and clear escalation visibility

Team mapping and stakeholder management

  • Build and maintain a living map of Microsoft's field org across ISV and enterprise-facing teams - who owns which accounts, who moves deals, who has co-sell budget

  • Develop working relationships with PDMs, field AEs, and ISV partner managers at Microsoft

  • Serve as Fireworks AI's primary point of contact for joint business reviews, pipeline reviews, and co-sell coordination

Sales plays and enablement

  • Develop sales plays tailored to the ISV and enterprise motion - positioning Fireworks AI's inference platform against the decision criteria that matter in each segment

  • Build and deliver enablement for Microsoft field sellers on Fireworks AI: clear, crisp positioning they can use in front of customers without a technical translator

  • Design the intake, escalation, and co-sell workflows that keep deals from stalling

Joint planning and operations

  • Own joint business planning with Microsoft counterparts: territory plans, account maps, co-sell targets, and QBR cadences

  • Coordinate co-marketing moments (joint events, solution briefs, field plays) that generate ISV and enterprise pipeline

  • Surface field intelligence from Microsoft conversations back to Fireworks AI's product and GTM teams

You're a good fit if you

  • Have 7+ years in GTM, partnerships, or field sales at a technology company - and a track record of operating fast when the environment changes

  • Know how Microsoft's field org actually works: account teams, SSPs, GBBs, marketplace mechanics, co-sell programs, MACC spend, partner incentives - and how to activate them at the deal level

  • Build systems, not just run plays. You document the motion, create the playbooks, and make it repeatable

  • Are comfortable owning a number before all the conditions are perfect, and stay accountable on pipeline sourcing, progression, forecasting

  • Can communicate clearly and concisely - you translate complex platform capabilities into a value story a non-technical field seller can use in front of a customer

  • Hold yourself accountable to pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy - not just relationship depth

The technical bar

This is not an engineering role. But it requires genuine curiosity about how AI inference platforms work.

You'll need working fluency in model serving, inference optimization, and AI training infrastructure - enough to speak credibly about why Fireworks AI's platform matters to ISVs and enterprises evaluating options in the market. If you don't have that fluency today, you can build it here - we'll help. What you can't be is someone who deflects every technical question or can't hold a credible 30-minute conversation with a solutions architect or a technical evaluator.

The through-line: you need to understand what we do well enough to translate it for someone who doesn't. That's the bar.

Nice to have

  • Experience working at or within a hyperscaler partner ecosystem (Microsoft, AWS, GCP)

  • Experience selling or partnering in AI/ML infrastructure, model serving, or MLOps

  • Experience working with ISVs at the platform layer - understanding their build-vs-buy decisions and procurement dynamics

  • Non-linear career path - varied, scrappy backgrounds carry real weight here

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

jobs.description:
VP of Sales, EMEA

A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

This is the seat where EMEA goes from early traction to a real engine: you own the number, you build the team, and you stay close enough to the deals to feel every one of them.

What that looks like day to day

Our GTM team is growing quickly. In London we already have pods across Enterprise Sales, Commercial Sales, Customer Success, BDR and Solutions Engineering, with a mix of internally promoted and externally hired first-line and segment leaders in place.

You own the EMEA revenue number, including new business and the bulk of net retention across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise. You lead the EMEA sales org directly, setting the bar on hiring, performance, coaching and territory design. You partner with in-region CS, SE, BDR and expansion account management to make the full regional motion work.

This is not a role you can do from behind a forecast. You'll be in the deals, running exec-level conversations with CTOs, CIOs and CISOs, inspecting and coaching pipeline personally, and carrying the deals that need you. You'll also drive operational excellence across pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, recruiting, enablement, fiscal planning and territory design.

Our leaders are close to the product, close to customers, and close to cross-functional peers. You'll work closely with our founders, COO, CMO, VP Finance, RevOps and Product, and build trust with Engineering, Marketing, Finance and company leadership. What you hear in region should influence the roadmap, and you'll contribute to company-wide planning and exec discussions, helping shape our global growth trajectory.

We want a real point of view on AI in GTM. How your team prospects, researches, qualifies, forecasts and closes should look different because of it.

You also set the cultural tone in London: a high performance bar, and a culture people want to be part of.

Who you are

  • You're based in or around London, and you're up for travelling across EMEA and occasionally to the US.

  • You've built an EMEA revenue engine from roughly $XXM to $XXXM at a high-growth B2B software company, and you have the appetite and resilience to take us from early traction to sustained scale in a Series B environment.

  • You've built and scaled sales teams across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise, and you know how the motion, hiring bar and cadence differ across each.

  • You're hands-on. You still get into deals, run discovery, coach live calls and hold a point of view on the product. You're not two layers removed from the customer.

  • You understand technical sales and have a track record selling to CTOs, CIOs and CISOs.

  • You have a real point of view on leveraging AI in GTM, grounded in things you've actually rolled out rather than things you've read about.

  • You keep a high performance bar while building a culture aligned with our values. We want both, and candidates who can only do one are not a fit. You're also an exceptional recruiter who attracts and retains A-players, and people follow you.

  • You build trust extensively across Engineering, Product and company leadership, and you're operationally excellent, with a bias for clarity, measurement and predictable execution.

Bonus points if you have experience scaling footprint into other European markets such as France, DACH and the Nordics. VP of EMEA Sales experience at a high-growth SaaS company scaling from $XXM to $XXXM+ is a plus, as is senior regional leadership at a $10B+ B2B software company with material revenue responsibility. We'd also love experience selling to engineering and SRE buyers in the reliability, observability, monitoring or DevOps space, early channel and alliances go-to-market experience, and the ability to lead cross-cultural teams across Europe.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Draft Showdown

About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

  • Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

  • Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

  • Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture

  • Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

  • Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment)

  • Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

  • Background in high-scale systems

  • Understanding of Unix-like environments

  • Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

  • Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.

  • A deep interest in game development is a plus.

  • Based or willing to relocate in Paris

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation

  • Other benefits according to the country you reside

Alongside recruitment, you’ll have the opportunity to support or lead a defined project, with guidance from the team. This could include:

  • Campus program: develop school and university relationships, coordinate student events, and help organise internship and apprenticeship recruitment campaigns.

  • Recruitment improvements: test new sourcing approaches, improve candidate communication, or contribute to our referral programme.

  • AI and recruitment tools: explore practical ways to support research, outreach preparation, and everyday workflows, and share what you learn with the team.

Your project scope will reflect your interests, the team’s priorities, and the duration of your internship or apprenticeship.

Who you are

  • You’re looking for a final-year internship or an apprenticeship as part of your studies.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Designer
jobs.description:
Senior Marketing Designer 
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

The Role

The title says "marketing designer". The job is much bigger than that. You'll help decide how our brand evolves as we move into bigger markets with bigger ideas.

You will be seen as a leader within the TrustedHousesitters creative studio and bring innovative, creative ideas to the table.

Our tone is bold, cheeky and a little rebellious, and we want someone who can push that further while keeping the trust our members rely on.

This is a hands-on senior role. You'll take work nose to tail, from the first idea to delivering every piece of artwork, with performance data showing how you're doing.

What you'll do

  • Take always-on paid social, our biggest acquisition lever, from concept to delivery. That means ads that are funny, bold and different and still hit conversion and engagement benchmarks.
  • Lead creative ideas on your own, pulling together small groups (usually you and a copywriter) and bringing strong, goal-focused concepts back to the senior team
  • Bring the brand to life through motion, animation and video, and take the lead on motion across the studio.
  • Help to support on larger brand activation briefs such as photography, motion shoots and events.
  • Support the Marketing Design Lead on major brand campaign moments, and help develop and evolve our brand look and feel.
  • Design campaign visuals and digital content across paid, organic and owned channels (social, video, landing pages, UGC)
  • Prototype quickly and iterate with modern workflows, including gen AI tools, and lead the studio on tooling.
  • Optimise creative using performance data and leveraging the insights to creatively advertise to our ICPs.
  • Raise the bar on craft through thoughtful peer feedback and light-touch mentoring of more junior studio members.

What you'll need

  • Nose-to-tail creative ownership: a track record of turning ideas into finished, multi-format artwork, at pace and on a regular basis
  • Motion and video craft: strong After Effects and Premiere Pro (or equivalent), and a portfolio that shows real motion work, not just static design with a bit of animation
  • Performance creative: hands-on experience designing for paid social and digital ad formats (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, GDN), including vertical, short-form and UGC-style content, and using data to improve results
  • Idea generation: confident developing campaign ideas, not just executing someone else's and being proactive into bringing your own ideas to the senior leadership teams.
  • Range and brand judgement: able to flex into a cheeky, irreverent tone while keeping brand consistency across evolving formats
  • A scale-up mindset: happy to switch from an SLT-level brand moment to a quick asset request in the same week, with no egos and plenty of pace
  • Tools: Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and gen AI tools used in your actual workflow

Nice to have

  • On-set or shoot experience (briefing, art direction, working with talent, and bonus points for animals)
  • Experience with digital products, online memberships or trust-based marketplaces
  • Experience at a brand scaling into the US or other international markets
  • A pet, travel or digital product background


You'll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads, but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies. Trust, transparency and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply:

  • You see seniority as a step away from the smaller stuff. Here, everyone gets stuck in, whatever the size of the brief.
  • You'd rather hand motion off to someone else. Motion is a big part of this role, and we need you to own it.
  • You need a fully formed brief before you start. You'll help shape the idea as much as deliver it.
  • Your work is mostly judged on how it looks. Ours is also judged on how it performs, and we iterate based on the data.
  • Premium and polished is your comfort zone, and cheeky feels off-brand to you. Our voice is bold, playful and a little rebellious.
  • You'd rather stay behind the screen than get involved in shoots and content production.

Our hiring process

  1. Intro video call with our Talent team

  2. Portfolio review with the Creative Studio

  3. A short, hypothetical creative task, followed by a conversation about your thinking

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.

Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.

jobs.description:
Delivery Manager

Join REMATIQ in revolutionizing medical innovation.

Join us on our mission to help medical innovators bring life-saving products to market faster and safer.

 

About REMATIQ

REMATIQ builds AI software for life sciences and medical device companies. Our platform helps teams automate complex documentation and compliance workflows, while keeping outputs traceable, reviewable, and audit-ready.

 

Product development in MedTech is highly complex: teams need to manage requirements, documentation, quality processes, regulatory expectations, and internal reviews across many systems and stakeholders. REMATIQ helps customers simplify this work, reduce manual effort, and move faster without compromising on quality or compliance.

 

We work with some of the world’s leading life sciences and MedTech companies, including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, and Novartis. We are backed by exceptional investors, having recently closed a Series A round.

 

This role will have a vital part in the shaping and growth of the Delivery organization with building up Customer Success, Support Engineering structures and also working towards internationalizing REMATIQ.

 

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

 

What you’ll do

As a Delivery Manager at REMATIQ, you will independently drive customer projects from problem framing to successful delivery. You will work closely with customers, our leadership team, Forward Deployed Engineers, MedTech Domain Experts, Product, and Engineering to turn complex customer needs into high-quality AI-powered workflows.

This is a hands-on project ownership role. You should be savvy and comfortable working with AI, software, implementation topics, and complex regulated workflows, but you will not be expected to be the technical expert or the MedTech domain expert.

 

You will:

  • Own customer delivery workstreams: Structure ambiguous problems, define the workplan, align stakeholders, manage risks, and drive projects to successful outcomes.

  • Lead customer interactions: Work directly with customer project teams and subject-matter experts to understand their goals, workflows, constraints, pain points, and success criteria.

  • Work hands-on with a cutting-edge AI platform: Deploy agents in mission-critical workflows at some of the world’s most innovative MedTech and life sciences companies.

  • Bring structure and insight: Frame complex issues clearly, break them down into practical next steps, push for insight, and turn ambiguity into decisions.

  • Create high-quality outputs quickly: Produce project plans, meeting materials, workflow documentation, decision documents, customer-facing drafts, internal summaries, and scalable delivery templates.

  • Become fluent in the REMATIQ product: Demo it, explain it, teach it, support customers after rollout, capture feedback, and identify opportunities for additional use cases.

 

What we’re looking for

We are looking for a top performer with exceptional project ownership, analytical horsepower, customer presence, and execution speed.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

 

  • Relevant background: 2–4 years in consulting, enterprise implementation, customer-facing project delivery, or a high-growth B2B SaaS / AI company, ideally in strategy, technology, transformation, or life sciences contexts.

  • Strong project ownership: You can take an ambiguous problem, structure it, identify what matters, define the workplan, and drive execution with limited guidance.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills: You are strong at conceptual framing, analysis, synthesis, and turning complex information into clear recommendations.

  • Strong customer presence: You can interact independently with customer project teams, build trust, manage expectations, and communicate clearly in meetings and written updates.

  • High execution quality and AI-native working style: You create strong drafts and polished deliverables quickly, and actively use AI tools to analyze, synthesize, improve outputs, and increase your own productivity.

  • Comfort with software and implementation topics: You are curious, fast-learning, and confident working with product, data, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions.

  • Startup mindset: You are adaptable, resilient, hands-on, positive under pressure, and willing to take on challenges beyond a narrow job description.

  • Fluency in English and German (mandatory).

 

Why join REMATIQ?

  • Rare timing: Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies at a pivotal stage as we move from Seed toward Series A and prepare to significantly grow the team.

  • Real ownership: Own high-impact customer projects and see your work translate directly into outcomes for leading MedTech and life sciences companies.

  • Unmatched exposure: Work directly with founders, customers, product teams, and technical experts while building a network across the global MedTech and life sciences industry.

  • Purposeful work: Be part of a mission-driven team transforming how medical devices reach the market — in an industry where quality, compliance, and patient safety mean nothing can be left to chance.

  • Compensation & growth: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a stake in the success you help create.

Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d)
Dein neuer Job

Unsere Vision ist eine offene, nachhaltige und friedliche Gesellschaft, in der Gutes tun mit Wirkung das gemeinsame Handeln leitet. Um dazu unseren Beitrag zu leisten, haben wir PHINEO als gemeinnützige Plattform für strategisches gesellschaftliches Engagement aufgebaut.

Gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen lassen sich heute nur gemeinsam lösen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Unternehmen, Stiftungen, Sozialunternehmen, öffentlichen Institutionen und zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen daran, sektorübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zu stärken und mehr Wirkung zu erzielen. Für unser Team in Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Beratungs-, Netzwerk- und Gestaltungskompetenz miteinander verbindet, als Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bringst Akteur*innen aus Wirtschaft, Zivilgesellschaft, Philanthropie und öffentlichem Sektor gezielt zusammen, um Kooperationen mit gesellschaftlichem Impact anzuregen. Dafür entwickelst du neue Formen der sektorübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit. Parallel gestaltest und moderierst du etablierte Dialogformate im analogen und digitalen Raum.
  • Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei IMPACT COLLECTIVES, unserem neuen Angebot, das Impact Startups mit Unternehmen, Investor*innen und weiteren Enablern aus Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und Zivilgesellschaft themenspezifisch verbinden wird und damit strukturellen Wandel entlang der großen gesellschaftlichen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit vorantreibt.
  • Du leitest unsere Corporate Citizenship Arbeitsgruppe, entwickelst sie strategisch weiter, gewinnst neue Unternehmen für die Mitwirkung. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit Vertreter*innen aus Wirtschaft, Zivilgesellschaft und öffentlicher Hand Impulse für eine wirksame gesellschaftliche Verantwortung von Unternehmen.
  • Du konzipierst, akquirierst und verantwortest Beratungs- und Kooperationsprojekte. Beispielsweise berätst du Startups, die wissen möchten, wie sie mehr Impact erzielen oder Investor*innen finden können, oder begleitest Kooperationen zwischen Unternehmen und Nonprofits prozessual wie inhaltlich.
  • Du steuerst komplexe Projekte eigenverantwortlich von der Konzeption über das Partnermanagement bis zur Umsetzung und Auswertung. Handlungsleitend sind für dich der angestrebte gesellschaftliche Mehrwert und eine wirtschaftliche Umsetzung.
Bei der Arbeit bist du selbstverständlich nicht auf dich allein gestellt. Vielmehr bist du Teil eines engagierten Teams, das verschiedene Kompetenzen und Perspektiven vereint.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für gesellschaftliche Transformation, nachhaltiges Wirtschaften und die Zusammenarbeit von Akteur*innen aus unterschiedlichen gesellschaftlichen Bereichen ein.
  • Du bringst die Energie, Überzeugungskraft und Empathie mit, die es braucht, um Vertrauen aufzubauen und Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu gewinnen. Auch skeptische Akteur*innen kannst du inspirieren und aktivieren.
  • Du bringst Beratungserfahrung mit, idealerweise mit Startups, Investor*innen oder Unternehmen zu Fragen rund um Strategie oder Organisationentwicklung. Daher kannst du Beratungsprozesse konzipieren, eigenständig durchführen und zu belastbaren Ergebnissen führen.
  • Du hast in der Vergangenheit bereits Netzwerke aufgebaut oder intensiv betreut, idealerweise mit Beteiligung von Akteuren aus der Wirtschaft und aus dem Startup-Bereich. Du kannst relevante Akteure zeitnah identifizieren und sie mit unseren Zielgruppen vernetzen. Du besitzt Erfahrungen mit Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen oder Collective-Impact-Ansätzen. 💻 Our Solution: At Skailark, we help airlines make smarter decisions — financially and environmentally. We’ve built a digital twin of the global aviation market, modeling every seat on every flight across every airline.

Trusted by airlines like American Airlines, British Airways, Finnair, and Transavia and airports such as London Heathrow, Skailark is where complex data meets real impact.

Ready to help shape the future of aviation?

Tasks

We are looking for two Senior Managers Aviation Data with a passion for building and expanding our digital twin of the global aviation market. You will shape the parts of our models that match your background and interests, from how aircraft and airline networks operate to what drives airline costs and financial performance. Working closely with our Head of Product, you will turn how aviation works in practice into accurate, scalable models. You will lead and develop a small team of 2–3 business analysts while staying hands-on yourself. jobs.title: Head of Finance (all genders) for reev
jobs.description:
Head of Finance (all genders) for reev

We are looking for a Head of Finance (all genders) for our portfolio company reev.

About reev

reev is becoming Europe's largest B2B platform for energy and charging management. We are on the path to 10,000 B2B customers, scaling energy management and our electricity tariff, and expanding into new business models and markets - organically and by acquisition in a market that is consolidating fast. This role decides whether we do that efficiently or expensively.

Finance at reev is not a support function. It is a lever. The person in this role is the CEO's closest counterpart on how the business works - analytically, commercially, and financially. You own the foundation that makes fast, confident decisions possible. You are joining our finance team and helping establish AI-first operations built to work at scale.

You own Finance end-to-end: Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, M&A, and the systems that make all of it faster and smarter. You report directly to the CEO and act as a strong counterpart to him. You are the person who pressure-tests every assumption, challenges the plan before the market does, and makes sure we are building a genuinely strong business model, not a story that only works on a slide.

Tasks

  • Own the operating model. Build an AI-first finance team that is faster, smarter, leaner.
  • Automate Finance. Monthly closing in half the time.
  • Control the right numbers. Burn Multiple, NRR, gross margin per product domain. You know which metrics drive the business and how to influence them positively.
  • Own the unit economics. A strong business model is not a by-product of growth - it is designed. You partner with Product and Commercial to shape pricing and packaging, define clear margin guardrails, and drive efficient ARR growth on unit economics that hold up at 10x the volume, protecting long-term contribution margins.
  • Manage energy finance. reev's electricity tariff brings its own complexity. Procurement risk, hedging, margin per kWh, working capital, and regulatory exposure. A distinct block, not a footnote.
  • Build investor readiness. Own the financial model, equity story, and data room. Ensure reev is always ready - with the numbers and the narrative to back it up.
  • Drive M&A and consolidation. Our market is consolidating and we intend to lead it. You watch the market continuously, build and own the target pipeline, run valuation, business case, due diligence and negotiation, and land the integration afterwards - buying into new markets and strategic business fields is a core engine of our growth, not an opportunistic side bet.
  • Prepare Finance for growth. New products, billing models, new entities, internationalisation. Finance enables expansion - it does not slow it down.

Requirements

Must-haves:
AI as a tool for efficiency, not a talking point. You have built processes with AI and hold yourself accountable for the outcome.

  • Start-up or scale-up experience. You build before the structure exists.
  • Hands-on. You lead by doing, not by delegating the hard parts.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset. You don't wait to be told where the problem is. You see around corners, connect the dots between Finance and the business model, and push the company forward - not just report on it.
  • Numbers into decisions. You work with the metrics that matter, not just the ones that are easy to report.
  • The confidence to challenge upwards. You say what the numbers mean, even when it is uncomfortable.
  • Strong Accounting and FP&A foundation. You lead across both disciplines, not just one.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with energy or hardware-adjacent business models. Tariff economics, working capital through prepayments, regulatory exposure.
  • M&A experience with real ownership. You have screened targets, built the business case, run due diligence and seen at least one deal through integration - not just supported a process from the side.

We don't expect every box ticked. But we do expect you to care deeply, move fast, and hold yourself to a high standard. Sound like you? Let's talk.

Benefits

How we work
Clear goals. Real ownership. No politics. We move fast, decide together, and hold each other accountable -because progress beats perfection. Monthly team events and regular cross-office collaboration between Munich and Zagreb keep us connected as one team.

Where you'll work
Our office at Stiglmaierplatz is where collaboration happens face-to-face, shoulder to shoulder. For this role, we expect you on-site five days a week. Not because we track attendance, but because the best outcomes happen when great people are in the same room - and this role sits at the heart of that.

What you get

  • 28 vacation days. Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously. Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits. Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably. JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget. Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted. Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fine print.
    Benefits may vary slightly by location. Your recruiter will walk you through what applies to your role.

reev makes EV charging smart and energy management simple - for over 7,000 companies across Europe.

We’re building the infrastructure Europe truly needs: charging, energy, and buildings - all connected in a system that simply has to work for our customers. The market is fast-paced, complex, and full of unanswered questions. That’s exactly why we’re looking for people who don’t wait for perfect conditions.

If you want ownership, reev is the right place for you. You’ll be given responsibility with the freedom to act. We make decisions, we deliver, we improve - openly, respectfully, and with an eye toward what really works in the end.

We work across teams, locations, and markets - pragmatically and in close coordination. For us, responsibility means: seeing things through to the end, clarifying dependencies early on, asking for help when things get stuck, and sharing knowledge so others can move faster.

For us, diversity isn’t just a badge - it’s a measure of quality: different perspectives improve decision-making - especially when the pace is fast and complexity is high. jobs.title: Global Director of Product
jobs.description:
Global Director of Product

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

We are looking for a Global Director of Product for Flex to lead the product strategy, direction, and organisation behind Kraken's global flexibility platform. Kraken Flex connects distributed energy resources to energy markets at scale — operating across Liberalised Markets, where we trade flexibility directly, and Regulated Markets, where we partner with utilities and DSOs to deliver grid services.

This is a pivotal executive product role at the heart of Kraken's fastest-growing business unit. You will own the product direction, roadmap, culture, and delivery effectiveness of the shared Flex platform — the core set of capabilities that both business units depend on to compete and grow.

Your mandate is to evolve the Flex platform into a scalable, differentiated capability that creates long-term strategic advantage: meaningfully ahead of anything the flexibility market has built.

 
 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

You will lead the product organisation across all shared Flex platform squads — the teams building the core capabilities that underpin Liberalised and Regulated Markets propositions globally. You will work with the VP of Engineering for Flex, together accountable for the quality, culture, and strategic direction of the Flex technology organisation.

The shared platform sits at the intersection of two distinct business models, multiple geographies, and a constantly evolving set of market requirements. The central challenge of this role is making the right calls about what the platform should build, in what sequence, and why — while holding the tension between serving immediate business needs and protecting long-term platform integrity.

 
 

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Product Strategy and Roadmap: Own the product vision and roadmap across all Flex platform squads. Ensure it is genuinely aligned with Flex's long-term strategy and the priorities of both business units — not a backlog of requests from the loudest stakeholder.

  • Cross-BU Alignment: Work alongside Proposition Product Leaders across Liberalised and Regulated Markets to identify what the platform should build to unlock their roadmaps, and which capabilities developed in proposition teams are ready to become shared platform features. Make those calls with clarity and conviction.

  • Platform Strategy: Identify and drive capabilities emerging from proposition teams. Ensure the shared platform evolves toward reusable, composable architecture — balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform coherence.

  • Product Culture and Practice: Build and sustain a high-performing product organisation. Define how teams discover, prioritise, and deliver. Mentor Product Managers across Flex, set the bar for product excellence, and create the conditions for PMs to meet it.

  • Competitive Positioning: Maintain a clear picture of where Flex has capability gaps versus alternatives in the market. Own the plans to close those gaps before they become liabilities.

  • Long-Term Differentiation: Look beyond the current roadmap. Identify technology and product investments that create durable, hard-to-replicate advantage for Kraken Flex, and work with Flex GMs to prioritise them.

🧠 What you'll bring:


Essential Experience

  • Executive Product Leadership: Proven experience building and leading product organisations — not just managing product teams. You've shaped culture, developed people, and elevated the function around you.

  • Platform Product Expertise: Deep experience in platform or shared infrastructure product contexts — building capabilities that serve multiple internal customers with competing priorities, without losing coherence or quality.

  • Commercial Acumen: A track record of connecting product decisions to business outcomes and making the case for long-term platform investment in commercial terms. You can represent product strategy credibly to executive leadership.

  • Engineering Partnership: Genuine experience co-owning roadmaps and co-building organisations with engineering leadership as a peer — not a handoff relationship.

  • Organisational Complexity: Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple business units, market models, or geographies — making decisions that serve the whole without losing sight of the specific.


Leadership & Mindset

  • You possess a rare combination of strategic clarity and operational discipline — you can define where the platform needs to be in three years while staying close enough to delivery to know when something's going wrong today.

  • You are a product leader who builds organisations, not just products. The PMs around you get better because of you.

  • You thrive in environments where the answer isn't obvious. You can hold the tension between serving immediate business needs and protecting long-term platform integrity, and make good decisions in that space.

  • You embody the ability to "think long-term and ship next week."

 
 

⭐️ Bonus points:

  • Experience in energy trading, utilities, or distributed energy resources used for grid flexibility.

  • Experience building platforms that serve both internal proposition teams and external partners or customers.

  • Prior experience scaling a product organisation through a period of rapid, sustained growth.
