jobs.description:
Lead Procurement In-House Engine development

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

Reports to: Head of Procurement

Role Overview

We are looking for a Lead In-house Development Procurement to lead procurement for TEC’s internally developed engines and assigned future programs. You will own procurement strategy and supplier delivery across Scirocco, Storm and the future-program perimeter. You will translate evolving engineering requirements into sourcing plans, robust contracts and supplier commitments that support development and testing milestones. You will build dedicated procurement capability for these programs while respecting TEC’s overall priority of delivering Nyx Earth.

Key Responsibilities

Supplier and Contract Management

  • Define sourcing strategies for development hardware, components and specialist services within the assigned programs.

  • Identify and develop suppliers capable of meeting demanding technical requirements and evolving development schedules.

  • Lead major negotiations and ensure contracts address scope, technical annexes, delivery milestones, acceptance, intellectual property and change management.

  • Monitor supplier performance and lead recovery plans for critical delivery or technical issues.

  • Assess supply risks, including single-source dependencies, capacity constraints and long-lead items.

Development Procurement

  • Own procurement activities from early supplier engagement and RFQs through contract execution and delivery.

  • Work with Engineering and program teams to establish clear procurement packages and realistic sourcing schedules.

  • Ensure technical requirements and changes flow into supplier contracts with appropriate cost and schedule visibility.

  • Support prototype builds, test campaigns and successive hardware iterations.

  • Coordinate test hardware and test-stand requirements with the indirect procurement and DMP teams, assigning clear ownership for each package.

  • Ensure procurement activity follows company sourcing, approval and quality requirements.

Strategic Leadership

  • Maintain an integrated procurement plan for Scirocco, Storm and assigned future programs.

  • Allocate team capacity according to approved program milestones and company priorities.

  • Develop supplier capability for progression from development hardware toward repeatable manufacture.

  • Identify opportunities to reuse suppliers, contractual approaches and purchasing experience across programs.

  • Resolve resource and supplier conflicts with the Nyx procurement lead, escalating decisions that could affect Nyx delivery.

Team Leadership and Collaboration

  • Lead and develop the Principal Storm Procurement role and the procurement managers responsible for lunar lander and future-program activities.

  • Delegate Storm procurement leadership to the Principal Storm Procurement, with the Storm Procurement Manager reporting through that role.

  • Set clear accountability for supplier strategy, negotiations, execution and escalation.

  • Work closely with Engineering, program leadership, Quality, Finance and the other procurement leads.

  • Provide the Head of Procurement with a consolidated assessment of delivery risks, commercial exposure and required decisions.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Significant procurement experience supporting complex hardware development in aerospace, propulsion or a comparable engineering environment.

  • Experience negotiating technically demanding development and manufacturing contracts.

  • Demonstrated experience leading procurement teams and managing suppliers through changing requirements.

  • Experience supporting prototype builds, testing or the transition from development into production.

Skills

  • Strong technical understanding and the ability to challenge incomplete or ambiguous requirements constructively.

  • Advanced negotiation and commercial risk management skills.

  • Ability to manage technical annexes, contractual flow-down and change-control exposure.

  • Sound judgment when balancing development speed, cost, quality and delivery.

  • Ability to develop senior procurement professionals and delegate meaningful ownership.

  • Clear, concise communication of risks, options and recommendations.

  • Experience developing engines or propulsion systems for Spacecraft is a strong plus

Why Join Us

  • Help deliver Nyx Earth and develop the capabilities behind TEC’s future vehicles and engines.

  • Take ownership of a procurement function with a direct impact on company milestones.

  • Lead and develop a team in a collaborative, international engineering environment.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

As Head of Customer Success, you build and lead the function that takes care of our infrastructure customers once the contract is signed. Product Owner (m/w/d)

Schaust du in den Spiegel und siehst das lebende Beispiel für gute Kommunikation, Konzeption und lösungsorientiertes Denken? In der nächsten Zeit wollen wir ein neues Entwicklerteam aufbauen – und du könntest eine Schlüsselrolle darin spielen. Wenn du Bock hast, mit uns gemeinsam die Agenturwelt mit innovativen digitalen Produkten zu begeistern, melde dich!

  • Als Schnittstelle zwischen unseren verschiedenen Teams bist du der erste Ansprechpartner bei Fragen und gibst regelmäßig Updates zum derzeitigen Projektstatus

Sicherheit & Perspektive

Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.

Geek paradise

Egal ob Kubernetes, Microservices oder React - bei uns kannst du das richtig nice Zeug machen. Damit du dein Bestes geben kannst, bist du der Admin auf deinem Gerät und hast die freie Wahl bei deiner Hardware und der Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.

Aktiver Teil der Community

Wir sind Teil der Open Source und Linux Community. Teile unseres Stacks stellen wir zur freien Verfügung, entwickeln von uns genutzte Open Source Projekte aktiv weiter und sponsern Projekte und Events im Open Source Kontext. Und wir unterstützen deine Community-Arbeit.

Wir wollen, dass du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst. Dabei unterstützen wir dich aktiv durch Weiterbildungen, Schulungen und unser Coaching-Angebot. Du siehst ein spannendes Thema, das dich und uns voranbringt? Dann nimm dir die Zeit, dich damit zu beschäftigen.

Dein Einfluss

Mitdenker gesucht! Wir geben deinen Ideen Raum und sind offen für Neues. So entwickeln wir uns als Unternehmen stetig weiter. Du möchtest was bewegen? Bring dich ein und lass deinen Gedanken freien Raum. Wir leben echte Mitbestimmung - unabhängig von Rolle und Titel.

Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden

Du kannst dich auf Angebote rund um deine körperliche und mentale Gesundheit (wie Sportnavi, aktive Pause, etc.), unser Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits freuen. Natürlich ist bei uns auch für Vitamine, Koffein & H2O gesorgt.

Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Manager:innen zusammen und erhältst fundierte Einblicke in den gesamten Vertriebs- und Beziehungszyklus im B2B-Umfeld.

In deiner Rolle übernimmst du eine unterstützende Funktion im Tagesgeschäft und wirkst insbesondere bei folgenden Aufgaben mit:

  • Du erstellst kaufmännische und konzeptionelle Angebote, präsentierst diese in Terminen, Workshops und Unternehmenspräsentationen und positionierst Acture als langfristigen Partner

  • Du sammelst Kunden- und Partneranforderungen und gibst diese strukturiert an unsere internen Teams weiter
  • Du vertrittst Acture bei Veranstaltungen vor Ort, wie z.B. Messeauftritten und Branchenevents
  • Du bringst Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Partner- und Vertriebsprozesse optimieren und die Qualität unserer Arbeit kontinuierlich steigern können.
So erhältst du einen umfassenden Einblick in strategischen B2B-Vertrieb im Gesundheitskontext und entwickelst schrittweise eigene Verantwortungsbereiche.


Dein Profil

Wir suchen motivierte, strukturierte und lernbereite Persönlichkeiten, die Interesse an Vertrieb, Partnerschaften und Betrieblichem Gesundheitsmanagement haben.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und professionell und fühlst dich im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner:innen wohl
  • Du bist engagiert, proaktiv und möchtest dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien zu 100 %? Bewirb dich gerne trotzdem! Wir berücksichtigen individuelle Stärken und Entwicklungspotenziale.


Warum wir?

Als Teil des Acture Teams in Deutschland bist du von aufgeschlossenen, smarten Menschen umgeben, die mit Leidenschaft an unserer gemeinsamen Mission arbeiten. Dabei legen wir Wert auf ein gesundes Umfeld zum Arbeiten und Leben, einschließlich flexibler Arbeitszeiten und Home Office.

dida entwickelt individuelle Machine-Learning-Software für Industrie-Kunden, darunter Siemens, Deutsche Bahn, idealo, klöckner.i und Enpal. Unser Team besteht überwiegend aus Machine Learning Scientists, viele davon promoviert, und verbindet wissenschaftliche Tiefe mit echten Geschäftsanforderungen.

Im Private-Sector-Team verantworten wir das Industriegeschäft. Wir identifizieren die Unternehmen, für die KI und ML gerade wirtschaftlich relevant wird, und begleiten sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Projektstart. Für den Ausbau unserer Kundenansprache suchen wir Verstärkung.


Dein Profil

Du übernimmst unseren Outreach. Dafür existiert ein eingespielter Tech-Stack aus Outreach-Automatisierung, LinkedIn-Tooling, Kontaktdatenbanken und CRM. Wir suchen die Person, die diesen Bereich ownt: Kampagnen aufsetzen, Zielgruppen bauen, Ergebnisse nachhalten und die Daten in einem Zustand halten, auf den wir uns verlassen können.

Du arbeitest dabei direkt mit unserem Business Development und Sales-Team zusammen. Die Rolle ist dynamisch, neben dem Outreach kommen kurzfristige Themen aus dem Tagesgeschäft dazu.

Ein relevanter Teil der Arbeit ist operativ: Listen pflegen, Kontaktdaten prüfen, Antworten sortieren, Sequenzen nachziehen. Das schreiben wir offen hin, weil es die Grundlage für alles Weitere ist.

  • Studium: Du studierst Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder etwas Vergleichbares.

  • Business-Interesse: Du denkst unternehmerisch und willst verstehen, wie Industrieunternehmen Entscheidungen treffen und warum sie kaufen.

  • Zuverlässigkeit: Du bringst klar definierte Aufgaben eigenständig zu Ende, hältst Absprachen ein und dokumentierst deine Arbeitszeit nachvollziehbar.

  • Tool-Affinität: Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Software ein und hast Freude daran, Abläufe zu automatisieren. Erste Erfahrung mit CRM- oder Outreach-Tools hilft, wir setzen sie nicht voraus.

  • Kommunikation: Du schreibst klar und fehlerfrei auf Deutsch und gehst auf Menschen zu, am Telefon wie auf Messen.

  • Sprachen: Dein Deutsch ist mindestens auf C2-Niveau, weil du unsere Kundenansprache im DACH-Raum schreibst. Mit Kolleg*innen verständigst du dich teilweise auch auf Englisch. 

  • Rahmen: Du wohnst in Berlin, studierst noch mindestens drei Semester und möchtest ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten.

  • Kein Muss, aber ein Plus: erste Erfahrung aus Praktika oder Werkstudierendenjobs im Vertrieb oder im Startup-Umfeld, oder eigene unternehmerische Initiative.

Auch wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung.

  • Team: Knapp 40 Leute aus unterschiedlichen Disziplinen, viele mit Promotion in Mathematik oder Physik.

  • Flexibilität: Hybride Arbeitszeiten, abgestimmt auf deinen Stundenplan.

  • Büro: Berlin-Kreuzberg am Moritzplatz, mit gutem Kaffee.

  • Lebenslauf (erforderlich)

  • Immatrikulationsbescheinigung (erforderlich)

  • Notenübersicht, falls vorhanden

  • Angabe deiner möglichen Wochenstunden und deines frühestmöglichen Starts

jobs.description:
Applied Machine Learning Engineer, EMEA

About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you are the technical owner of a customer engagement. This is what is globally known as the Forward Deployed Engineer role; at Fireworks in EMEA it carries the AMLE title. You embed with a small number of accounts, work in their environment, and own whatever stands between them and production on Fireworks: the model, the serving path, the integration, the performance. You scope the work before signature and deliver what you scoped. Depth over breadth: few accounts, owned end to end.

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.

Four Spikes:

  1. Software engineering. You ship production systems and are comfortable dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or a customer environment with a deadline. Backend and systems depth, strong Python plus at least one systems language, and fluency with AI-assisted and agentic engineering as a core part of how you build.

  2. Machine learning. You take open models and make them better on a customer's task: SFT, LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods, reinforcement learning (RLHF, RLVR), distillation. Just as important, you design evaluations that reflect the real task and let them drive training decisions, and you know when fine-tuning is not the answer.

  3. Infrastructure and performance. You know your GPUs: memory bandwidth, kernels, parallelism, what utilization numbers actually mean. Serving and inference optimization: quantization, speculative decoding, batching, KV cache behavior, latency vs throughput tradeoffs, multi-GPU and multi-node serving, capacity planning. You can take a deployment that works and make it fast and economical, and reason about where the bottleneck is before touching a profiler.

  4. Customer engagement. You want to be in the room. The point of this role is creating specialized intelligence for each customer: the best model for their task, their data, their constraints. That takes real interest in the customer's problem, not just the technical one. Exceptional here looks like founder energy with customers; the floor is genuine appetite to embed, explain, and own outcomes with them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Engagements: Take customer deployments from scoping through production, as the single accountable technical owner.

  • Embed: Work directly inside customer teams; understand their domain, data, and constraints well enough to make decisions they trust.

  • Train and Tune: Run fine-tuning and post-training work where the engagement needs it, from data to evaluation to a model serving in production.

  • Optimize: Drive serving performance and cost on Fireworks: model choice, deployment shape, and inference optimization.

  • Scope Honestly: Assess what is achievable before we commit, and inherit what you scope.

  • Product Signal: Feed what customers need back to product and engineering, with enough precision to be actionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Spikes in two or all three areas.

  • For the ML spike: formal training (PhD, PhD in progress, or a strong MSc) and experience post-training LLMs specifically.

  • For the infrastructure spike: experience with GPU infrastructure, distributed serving, or inference engines.

  • Founder or founding engineer experience.

  • Experience in a startup or fast-paced environment.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: AI Field Engineer, EMEA
jobs.description:
AI Field Engineer, EMEA

About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

In the last few months alone we launched Fireworks Training, partnered with Microsoft Azure Foundry, and published research straight from our production systems. A few examples of what that looks like in practice:

  • Frontier RL is cheaper than the mega-cluster narrative suggests: we ran cross-region rollouts using 98% sparse weight deltas and published what we learned. (blog)

  • Open source agents with frontier advisors: matching frontier performance through training and harness engineering. (blog)

  • The fine-tuning bottleneck is not the algorithm: integration friction and iteration speed are what actually stall teams; we documented the patterns across dozens of customer engagements. (blog)

The Role

AI Field Engineers at Fireworks are the technical tip of the spear. You embed with our most ambitious customers and technology partners to turn complex AI problems into production systems, fast. The role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. You are hands-on-keyboard building POCs, MVPs, and production integrations, while also holding your own in executive-level conversations about architecture, strategy, and business outcomes.

You spend most of your time building. You ship code, run benchmarks, debug production issues, and architect deployments. But you also lead discovery conversations, align stakeholders, and translate customer pain points into product improvements that compress the feedback loop from field to roadmap. This is a role for engineers who are comfortable on-site with customers, building the relationships and trust that happen in person, not just over a call.

The Segment

As a Field Engineer in the Enterprise track you will work with large organizations and digital-native companies adopting GenAI across the business. These engagements span more stakeholders and longer cycles, so you will manage executive relationships and align teams while staying hands-on in the code. The emphasis is on pairing strong technical delivery with the executive presence to earn trust across an org: discovery, solution design, POC execution, and the path to production at enterprise scale.

What You'll Work On

Technical Delivery and Deployment

  • Build end-to-end POCs and MVPs alongside customer engineering teams, working inside their codebases, infrastructure, and constraints.

  • For customers whose core product is built on GenAI, architect the inference foundations that capability depends on, and size deployments so they can scale in their market without infrastructure becoming the bottleneck.

  • Run load tests and establish latency, throughput, and cost baselines against realistic customer traffic profiles, and tune deployments to hit those targets

  • Deploy and validate new model families on inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang), determining optimal shapes, quantization configs, and serving patterns across workloads.

Model Strategy and Fine-Tuning

  • Guide customers on model selection, fine-tuning strategy (SFT, DPO, RFT), and evaluation methodology.

  • Build and run fine-tuning pipelines directly with customers, navigating trade-offs between model families, compute cost, and quality targets.

  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks that measure production-quality metrics, not just benchmark scores.

Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management

  • Many of our customers exist because of GenAI. Help them bake frontier model capabilities into their core offering and turn that into a durable competitive edge.

  • Lead structured discovery conversations to unpack customer pain points, constraints, and success criteria before proposing solutions.

  • Own the technical relationship from first engagement through production deployment. Earn trust with ML engineers and VPs in the same meeting.

  • Spend time on-site with customers. Build trust and momentum in person, embedding with their teams where the work happens.

Product Feedback and Platform Improvement

  • Identify recurring customer pain points and translate them into concrete product proposals, working directly with engineering and product to ship fixes and features.

  • Codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute them back to internal tooling, documentation, and the platform itself.

  • Feed customer signals (deployment patterns, failure modes, feature gaps) back into the product roadmap with specificity and urgency.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a hands-on, customer-facing technical role: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, Solutions Architect, ML Engineer with field exposure, or technical founder.

  • Demonstrated ability to build production software with customers, not just advise on it. You have shipped code running in someone else's production environment.

  • Strong Python skills. Comfortable reading, writing, and debugging production code. Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure engineering.

  • Working knowledge of the LLM stack: inference trade-offs, model serving, fine-tuning workflows (SFT at minimum; DPO/RFT a strong plus).

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and deploying models on GPU infrastructure.

  • Exceptional communication: able to run a sharp discovery call, present to a VP, and debug a latency issue with an ML engineer in the same afternoon.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years in technical field or engineering roles.

  • Experience with inference serving frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) and tuning deployments for real workloads.

  • Experience operating as a technical authority inside a customer's environment building within their infrastructure, navigating their constraints, and shipping code that runs in their production systems.

  • Track record taking GenAI POCs from prototype to production-scale deployments.

  • Experience with hyperscaler AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, GCP Vertex).

  • Experience building or integrating agentic systems, tool-use chains, or AI-native developer toolchains.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.description:
Senior Business Operations Manager

What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients across all industries with an initial focus on insurance to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The Senior Business Operations Manager is responsible for improving the operational structure, reporting and day-to-day governance that help the business run efficiently and consistently. This is a Senior Manager role: it requires strong, varied operational experience, the ability to lead medium-to-large or more complex cross-functional initiatives with some oversight, and the judgement to make well-reasoned recommendations that balance impact, risk and practicality. The role combines revenue operations, business analysis, process improvement, and quality management as part of a broader business operations remit. It works closely with the Head of Operations, the wider Operations function, the Go-To-Market team, and company-wide stakeholders to turn business priorities into clear processes, reliable reporting and practical operational improvements.

Key responsibilities

Revenue operations and Salesforce

  • Maintain and improve the revenue operations framework across GTM, including pipeline governance, forecasting cadence, sales process discipline and commercial reporting.

  • Your team acts as the business owner for Salesforce and connected revenue systems, ensuring they support current, often high stakes, operating needs, data quality and consistent adoption.

  • Support on integration and usage of other relevant systems and how they form the process, such as Planhat and Clari.

  • Define, monitor and interpret key commercial metrics such as bookings, recurring revenue, conversion rates, deal cycle, retention, productivity and forecast accuracy. Drive data consistency in both usage and interpretation across teams as it relates to measuring commercial health.

  • Document core processes, workflows and data definitions so commercial reporting remains reliable and easy to maintain in Confluence.

  • Train and support users to drive consistent usage, reduce process friction and improve reporting confidence.

PowerBI, reporting and analysis

  • Develop and maintain PowerBI dashboards and operational reporting packs for leadership and functional teams.

  • Respond to analysis requests from across the business, clarifying the business question, sourcing the right data and presenting clear, actionable findings.

  • Build reporting that helps the business understand performance, diagnose issues and make decisions with confidence.

  • Improve data consistency, definitions and reporting processes across teams.

  • Use analysis to support business cases, process changes, investment decisions and operational priorities.

Operational excellence and process improvement

  • Design, document and improve business processes so they are scalable, efficient and easy to follow. This could be across a wide range of areas, from Alliances, Marketing, Procurement, and more.

  • Define and lead medium-to-large cross-functional operational projects from diagnosis through to implementation and adoption, with appropriate oversight from senior leaders.

  • Proactively identify bottlenecks, duplication, control gaps and opportunities for improvement within Operations and across related functions, then recommend practical solutions that reduce cost, risk or manual effort. Provide support to implement these recommendations.

  • Establish operating rhythms, review cadences and governance forums that create accountability and visibility across the business.

  • Support change management by communicating the context, purpose and value of work clearly, engaging stakeholders and embedding new ways of working.

ISO9001 and quality management

  • Own the ongoing maintenance of ISO9001 accreditation and ensure the quality management system remains effective, current and audit-ready.

  • Coordinate internal audits, external assessments, corrective actions and continuous improvement activity.

  • Maintain quality documentation, process controls, evidence records and governance materials.

  • Work with process owners to ensure quality standards are embedded into day-to-day business operations.

  • Track non-conformities, risks and improvement actions through to completion.

People leadership and team development

  • Define and align team goals with the Operations direction, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable for delivery.

  • Manage workload, priorities, performance and an allocated team budget where applicable, balancing multiple high-priority deadlines and responding calmly to unexpected risks or issues.

  • Build capability within the team through regular feedback, mentorship, development planning and knowledge sharing, with limited people growth decisions made with supervisory approval.

  • Create a motivating, cohesive and engaging team environment by providing context, making clear decisions and ensuring feedback and priorities are transparent.

  • Promote cross-functional collaboration by documenting knowledge, sharing learnings and building trusted relationships with peers and stakeholders.

Skills and experience

  • Strong, varied experience in business operations, revenue operations, sales operations, commercial operations or a similar role, typically including 3-5 years of management experience.

  • Strong Salesforce ownership or administration experience, with the ability to translate business needs into practical system and process requirements.

  • Confident with PowerBI reporting and data visualisation capability, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Commercial awareness and confidence working with revenue, pipeline, forecasting and performance data.

  • Experience defining and leading medium-to-large cross-functional projects or initiatives, managing senior stakeholders independently and navigating ambiguity with sound judgement.

  • Understanding of ISO9001, quality management systems, audit preparation and continuous improvement principles.

  • People management experience, including coaching, prioritisation, performance management and team development.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data or process issues clearly to different audiences.

  • Organised, pragmatic and resilient, with the ability to balance strategic priorities with hands-on delivery, say no constructively where needed and keep a solutions-focused approach.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant

This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

US Marketing Lead

US Marketing Lead

Location: United States

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution.

The Role

The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States.

You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working.

You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team.

What You’ll Own

US Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities.

  • Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth.

  • Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market.

  • Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities.

Demand Generation and Campaigns

  • Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement.

  • Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments.

Sales Enablement

  • Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators.

  • Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward.

  • Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities.

  • Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement.

Events, Webinars, and Partnerships

  • Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment.

  • Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline.

  • Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging.

  • Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities.

Content, Customer Stories, and PR

  • Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets.

  • Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators.

  • Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars.

  • Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships.

  • Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market.

Product Positioning and Market Intelligence

  • Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative.

  • Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process.

  • Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively.

  • Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness.

  • Maintain clear dashboards and regular updates for Marketing and US commercial leadership.

  • Use performance data to improve targeting, messaging, campaign investment, and sales follow-up.

  • Establish a consistent process for evaluating what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Established a clear and credible US marketing strategy tied to Teton’s commercial goals.

  • Built a consistent campaign engine that generates qualified demand and supports pipeline growth.

  • Improved the quality and consistency of US sales enablement.

  • Created a repeatable approach to US events, webinars, partnerships, and account-based programs.

  • Expanded Teton’s library of US customer proof points and case studies.

  • Increased Teton’s visibility and credibility with senior living operators and industry stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

The Person We Think Will Thrive

You are commercially minded, comfortable working directly with sales, and focused on producing work that helps the company grow. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process, and you know how to balance brand building with near-term pipeline needs.

jobs.title: Director, APAC Go-to-Market
jobs.description:
Director, APAC Go-to-Market

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Director, APAC Go-to-Market to build and lead our GTM business in Asia Pacific, starting from Singapore.

APAC represents an important growth opportunity for Tailscale. We have strong conviction in the region and are looking for a leader who can turn that opportunity into a meaningful, durable business: building pipeline and revenue, developing a strong partner ecosystem, winning strategic customers, and building the team we need to scale.

We are looking for someone who has built a region before and wants to do it again from scratch. You will set the APAC go-to-market strategy, determine where and how we invest, recruit and lead our initial regional team, and be directly accountable for commercial results. You will have significant autonomy to determine what Tailscale needs to win in the region.

You will also be a hands-on commercial leader. You’ll spend time with customers and partners, help shape and close our most important opportunities, and develop a deep understanding of how technology companies need to go to market differently across APAC. You’ll bring those insights back to our global Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams and help Tailscale become a truly global company.

In this role, you will be able to hire the team you need to succeed. We suspect that will include Sales Development, Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, and Partner Marketing, but ultimately we will be open to your recommendation based on expertise. These hires will report directly to you with dotted lines to functional departments in North America and EMEA. You’ll lead that team as a region, while working closely with their functional counterparts elsewhere at Tailscale. This role will report to Tailscale’s President, Kevin Kotecki.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the APAC number. You will be accountable for regional pipeline creation and revenue growth. Establish clear targets, build the plan to reach them, maintain strong forecasting and pipeline discipline, and continuously adjust our approach based on what the data and the market tell us.
  • Build and execute Tailscale’s APAC go-to-market strategy. Determine which markets, customer segments, use cases, and routes to market offer the greatest opportunity for Tailscale. Translate global company strategy into a focused regional plan while recognizing that what works in North America or Europe will not always work in APAC.
  • Build a high-performing regional GTM organization. Recruit, lead, and develop exceptional sellers and other customer-facing talent in the region. Build a team that operates as one APAC organization while remaining tightly connected to its global functional counterparts. Create the culture, operating rhythms, and accountability required for a small regional team to move quickly and perform at a high level.
  • Lead from the front with customers. Personally engage in Tailscale’s most important opportunities in the region. Build relationships with senior technical and business leaders, help the team navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, and serve as executive sponsor for strategic customers. Stay close enough to the market to know why we are winning, why we are losing, and what needs to change.
  • Build Tailscale’s presence in the region. Establish Tailscale as a credible and increasingly visible technology company in APAC. Represent Tailscale with customers, partners, at industry events, and within the broader technology ecosystem. Develop the relationships and market intelligence that allow us to identify opportunities earlier than we otherwise would.
  • Be the voice of APAC inside Tailscale. Build a strong point of view on regional customers, competitors, partners, buying behavior, and market dynamics. Bring that perspective into company decisions about product, packaging, marketing, partnerships, and future investments.
  • Build the region for the long term. We expect the shape of our APAC organization to evolve considerably. Identify what capabilities and investments we need next, make thoughtful resource tradeoffs, and build systems that can scale beyond the first phase of the Singapore office.

What We Are Looking For

  • Significant experience in enterprise technology go-to-market, with meaningful experience leading Sales or a broader GTM organization across APAC.
  • You have done this before. You have helped build or materially scale an APAC business rather than only operating within an already mature regional organization.
  • A proven track record of owning and exceeding meaningful pipeline and revenue targets in a B2B technology business.
  • Deep familiarity with the APAC technology market and experience operating successfully across multiple countries and cultures, with particularly strong knowledge of Singapore and Southeast Asia.
  • Established relationships within the regional channel and partner ecosystem, along with a track record of turning those relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.
  • A strong network of exceptional GTM talent in the region. You know what great sellers and SEs look like and have demonstrated that you can attract them to work with you.
  • Experience leading complex enterprise opportunities personally. You are comfortable moving from regional strategy and forecasting into a customer meeting or deal review and materially improving the outcome.
  • Experience selling highly technical products to sophisticated buyers. Experience with infrastructure, networking, security, developer tools, cloud, or adjacent enterprise technology is particularly relevant.
  • Strong commercial judgment and analytical ability. You understand pipeline mathematics, forecasting, unit economics, market prioritization, and where to invest limited resources to produce the greatest return.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills. You can lead a regional team while partnering effectively with global Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations teams that you do not directly manage.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and strong executive presence with customers, partners, candidates, and internal leaders.
  • A builder’s mindset. You are comfortable with ambiguity, limited infrastructure, and changing plans, and you know how to introduce enough process and structure to improve execution without slowing the organization down.
  • High agency and low ego. You are willing to personally do the work required to establish the region while simultaneously building an organization that will eventually make you less central to every decision.
  • A strong perspective on how technology GTM is changing in the age of AI and what those changes mean for winning customers and building partnerships in APAC.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

VP, Engineering & Facilities

We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role

We are seeking a Vice President of Engineering & Facilities to define and scale the engineering systems, infrastructure, and technical capabilities that power our compounding and pharmacy fulfillment network.

This leader will own the design and evolution of our end-to-end engineering ecosystem, spanning facility design, cleanrooms, utilities, automation, manufacturing systems, and material flow from compounding through dispensing, packaging, and delivery.

You will serve as the senior-most engineering partner to Pharmacy, Operations, and Quality leadership. The role requires strong engineering judgment, executive leadership, and enough experience in GMP- and USP-regulated environments to translate quality requirements into practical facility and system designs.

This role is critical to enabling the next phase of our manufacturing and fulfillment expansion, including new facility builds, cleanroom environments, production lines, utility systems, equipment installations, and automation investments.

Success requires quickly building credibility across functions, establishing rigor in capital planning and technical decision-making, and ensuring internal teams, contractors, architects, and engineering partners deliver compliant, scalable solutions.

This leader will partner closely with senior leaders across Compounding Operations, Pharmacy Operations, R&D, Global Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance, and will lead a multi-disciplinary organization that may include Industrial Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Device Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and related technical teams.

This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership role: setting direction, building the function, developing leaders, and ensuring disciplined execution across a rapidly growing network.

What You’ll Do

Engineering Strategy & System Design

  • Define and lead the enterprise engineering strategy across compounding, pharmacy, and fulfillment operations.

  • Establish engineering standards and scalable operating models that can be replicated across sites.

  • Architect end-to-end workflows and technical systems connecting production, dispensing, packaging, storage, and delivery.

  • Provide technical leadership across mechanical, electrical, facilities, automation, manufacturing, and industrial engineering disciplines.

Facilities, Utilities, Capital & Network Expansion

  • Lead the design, expansion, commissioning, and ongoing support of regulated manufacturing and pharmacy facilities, including cleanrooms and controlled environments.

  • Ensure facility designs appropriately address personnel flow, material flow, airflow, HVAC, electrical systems, process utilities, equipment placement, maintainability, and future capacity.

  • Own and optimize large-scale capital investment planning, including facility builds, automation, equipment, utilities, and infrastructure programs of $100M or more.

  • Provide technical oversight of architects, engineering firms, contractors, equipment vendors, and external subject-matter experts; ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and monitor performance against technical and regulatory expectations.

  • Establish clear governance, reporting, risk management, and execution rigor for capital projects.

Compliance & Quality Integration

  • Partner closely with Quality, Pharmacy, and Operations to ensure engineering designs and systems meet applicable cGMP, FDA, Board of Pharmacy, and USP requirements, including USP , , and .

  • Translate regulatory and quality-system requirements into practical, scalable engineering standards and operating systems.

  • Build inspection readiness into facility, equipment, maintenance, utility, and change-control processes.

  • Promote a strong quality mindset while balancing compliance, speed, operational performance, and business growth.

Operational Excellence & Reliability

  • Improve throughput, accuracy, reliability, capacity, and cost through system design, automation, engineering improvements, and data-driven decision-making.

  • Develop enterprise approaches to preventive and predictive maintenance, asset lifecycle management, spare-parts strategy, and equipment reliability.

  • Use Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous-improvement methods as supporting tools rather than the sole focus of the engineering function.

  • Identify and close critical gaps across systems, workflows, infrastructure, and performance visibility.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing, multi-disciplinary engineering and facilities organization across a multi-site network.

  • Develop leaders, establish clear accountability, and strengthen technical capabilities across regulated environments.

  • Create organizational structure, succession plans, operating rhythms, and decision-making mechanisms that support rapid growth.

  • Serve as a key thought partner to senior leaders across Operations, Quality, Pharmacy, Supply Chain, Technology, Facilities, and Finance.

  • Lead through ambiguity and change while maintaining pace, alignment, and disciplined execution.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience building and scaling engineering organizations and leading through senior technical and people leaders across multiple sites.

  • Strong facilities and infrastructure experience, including cleanrooms or similarly controlled environments, HVAC, electrical systems, utilities, equipment installation, and facility expansion.

  • Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, or comparable multidisciplinary technical experience; ability to credibly lead and challenge specialists across these disciplines.

  • Demonstrated ownership of large-scale capital programs, including facility builds, automation, equipment, and infrastructure investments.

  • Foundational knowledge of GMP, USP, quality systems, validation, change control, and inspection-ready operations sufficient to partner effectively with Quality and regulated operations teams.

  • Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, medical devices, biotechnology, 503A/503B compounding, semiconductors, aerospace, automotive, electronics, or another high-precision and highly controlled manufacturing environment.

  • Experience overseeing external engineering firms, contractors, architects, and equipment vendors in complex technical projects.

  • Track record of improving reliability, throughput, quality, capacity, and cost through engineering and system-level improvements.

  • Strong executive communication, cross-functional influence, and ability to operate at both strategic and execution levels.

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field required; advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Experience

  • Direct experience with sterile manufacturing, aseptic processing, pharmacy compounding, 503A/503B operations, or USP , , and .

  • Experience designing, commissioning, qualifying, or operating cleanrooms and regulated facility systems.

  • Experience with automation, controls, robotics, and high-throughput manufacturing or fulfillment systems.

  • Lean Six Sigma or related continuous-improvement certification.

jobs.description:
Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d)

Deine Mission

Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster. Unsere KI-gestützte Software ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet wurden wir mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025 des ZIA (Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss). Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab.

Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Alle Quellen in einem Modell vereinen: Du kombinierst 2D-Katasterdaten, LiDAR-Punktwolken, Schrägluftbilder, Nadir-Satellitenbilder und weitere Quellen zur genauestmöglichen Abbildung der realen Welt.
  • Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich.
  • Texturiertes LoD3 erreichen: Du texturierst unsere Modelle aus Schrägluftbildern und erkennst Fenster, Türen und Fassadenelemente. Diese projizierst du konsistent auf die richtige Fläche des richtigen Gebäudes, damit Geschossflächen, Nutzflächen und Oberflächen deutlich präziser berechnet werden können.
  • Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte.

AI is about to change that fundamentally – and nobody has figured out yet what the interface for it looks like.

jobs.title: Senior Treasury Operations Analyst

Senior Treasury Operations Analyst

Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Treasury Operations team as a Senior Treasury Operations Analyst? Reporting to the Treasury Operations Lead, you will support Treasury Operations activities across ClearBank Group entities, including cash management, FX settlement, collateral and margin management and related processes. The role is responsible for executing complex operational activity with a high degree of accuracy and control, supporting day‑to‑day Treasury and contributing to the safe, resilient operation of a control‑critical function, while ensuring excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. As a senior member of the team, the role will deputise for the Treasury Operations Lead when required, providing operational leadership on shift, including coaching and direction to team members, while identifying efficiencies and continuous improvements across the function.

Please note - This role operates within a shift‑based Treasury Operations environment. Specific shift arrangements are communicated separately and may vary over time.

Your role includes:

  • Execute Treasury Operations activities across multiple ClearBank Group entities and multi‑currency Nostro accounts, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and strong control discipline

  • Perform and monitor FX settlement activity with multiple FX providers, resolving issues and exceptions within agreed procedures

  • Support cash and liquidity management processes, working closely with Treasury to manage intraday and end‑of‑day balances

  • Manage collateral and margin activity relating to UK securities, including transfers, settlement and ongoing monitoring of asset sales

  • Ensure all Treasury and cash management instruments, including FX swaps and money market funds, are confirmed and settled without exceptions

  • Deputise for the Treasury Operations Shift Manager when required, leading operational activity on shift and acting as a point of escalation within established BAU and contingency procedures

  • Exercise sound judgement during live operational issues, escalating in a timely manner where there is a high degree of certainty that existing processes or controls may fail

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance Treasury Operations processes, controls and workflows

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams and, where required, external counterparties to support smooth operational delivery

  • Produce operational reporting and management information as required to support oversight and decision‑making

  • Support the onboarding and operation of new Treasury instruments and products as ClearBank Group’s offering evolves

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Experience in Treasury Operations, cash management or payments operations within a regulated financial services environment

  • Strong working knowledge of FX settlement, Nostro account management and liquidity processes

  • Experience managing or supporting collateral and margin activity, including securities settlement

  • Proven ability to operate effectively in a time‑critical or shift‑based environment

  • Sound understanding of operational risk, controls and escalation frameworks

  • Experience producing or contributing to operational reporting and MI

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work confidently across teams and with external parties

Beneficial skills:

  • Experience supporting multiple legal entities and currencies

  • Exposure to new product or instrument launches within Treasury or Operations

  • Knowledge of UK securities settlement processes and market infrastructure

  • Experience contributing to process improvement or operational change initiatives

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data.
