jobs.title: Senior Product Quality Analyst - AI Voice
jobs.description:
Senior Product Quality Analyst - AI Voice

The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.

As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

 

What You'll Do
  • Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.
  • Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.
  • Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.
  • Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve.
  • Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.
  • Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.
  • Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.
  • Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities.

    • Who You Are
  • You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance.
  • You know how to independently define evaluation criteria and turn subjective qualities into clear, repeatable rubrics.
  • You are comfortable designing and running both qualitative and MOS-style evaluations and synthesizing the results into actionable insights.
  • You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly.
  • You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives.
  • You are comfortable working autonomously, identifying what needs to be evaluated and establishing the processes and cadence to make that evaluation useful over time.
  • You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors.
  • You are curious about generative AI, speech technology and the evolving AI voice landscape and can translate changes in the industry into meaningful benchmarks for Spotify.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
     
    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Analytics Engineer (Contract)

Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

We are accelerating. The product works, clients renew, the market is taking shape. Every day, shoppers talk to AI agents before they buy, and performance has been at the heart of how we build the product from day one. We now want to go further and faster: understand precisely what makes our campaigns and recommendations perform, and apply it to the product continuously.

As our freelance Analytics Engineer, full-time, you will dig into our data to find what drives performance, then turn your findings into changes in the product. You will work directly with the founders and the product and engineering teams.

Understand what drives performance

  • Explore every data source we have: conversations, web and behavioural events, campaign performance, product and advertiser metadata

  • Find what drives performance and size the impact of each lever

  • Measure every change with A/B tests, and feed the results back into the next analysis

Turn findings into changes

  • Apply what you find to the product yourself, with Claude Code: which products we prioritise, who we show them to, how we present them

  • Write and maintain the Claude Code skills that make these updates repeatable, reviewed by the engineering team

Build data that lasts

  • Model our data in BigQuery so every analysis can be rerun, not rebuilt

  • Build the semantic layer and the shared metrics the whole team relies on, readable by our agents and Claude Code skills as well as by people

  • Test and document your models so the team can trust them

  • Specify the events and properties we are missing, for the engineering team to implement

After 3 months

  • Our core performance metrics are modelled, tested and exposed in the semantic layer

  • Campaign performance has measurably improved: you ship changes every week, each one measured by A/B tests

  • The update loop runs through Claude Code skills the team can rerun

Profile

Must-have

  • 3+ years as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst or Data Engineer, with real analysis work

  • Advanced SQL, solid Python for analysis

  • Dimensional modelling on BigQuery (dbt or equivalent), with Git, pull requests and code review

  • You have built a semantic layer and BI on top of it (Lightdash, Looker or similar)

  • Solid statistics: A/B tests, ideally causal inference. You have turned an analysis into a product change and measured what it moved

  • Autonomous: you find the right questions in an open problem, turn your findings into clear recommendations, and challenge the requests you get

A plus

  • B2C, e-commerce, marketplace or advertising experience

  • Ads measurement: attribution, CTR, ROAS

  • You have put rerunnable data pipelines in production

  • Product analytics: PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel

  • Startup experience

The mission

  • Freelance, full-time, starting within 2 to 3 weeks

  • 3 months, renewable

  • For the right person, the mission can turn into a permanent role

  • Fluent French and professional English

  • Our stack: BigQuery, dbt, Lightdash, PostHog, Python

  • Process: a 30-minute technical fit, then a data exercise on a real dataset (2 to 3 hours on your side, then a 20-minute debrief of your insights). Decision within the week.

Why join us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

jobs.description:
Software Engineer (TypeScript) - Platform

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

The problem

Every medical centre has its own rules. Who can book what, with which practitioner, at what time, what to do with an urgent case at 6 pm. Today these rules live in prompts and in the heads of our ops team. Each new clinic takes hours of manual work, and the ops team is the bottleneck of our growth.

We are building the platform that removes that bottleneck. A scenario engine where the behaviour of the agent is structured configuration, not free text. A self-serve onboarding where a clinic connects its software and sets itself up. A dashboard where the medical staff stop executing and start supervising: the agent handles the volume, humans check what matters.

This is the difference between selling a service and selling a product. Every feature you ship here changes how fast Vocca can grow.

What you will do

  • Build features end to end on the platform: backend, dashboard, and the internal tooling that deploys clinics. You own a feature from the spec with the ops team to production.

  • Work on the scenario engine and the self-serve onboarding, the two biggest projects of the team this year.

  • Ship to more than 1,000 medical staff who use the product all day. A small change has an instant impact, which is rare for a team our size.

  • Learn from senior engineers who have built products before, and push them back when you think they are wrong.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere, backend and frontend (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, a design system written in code.
We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

How we build

  • We use AI seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks. If you have built your own agent workflows, you will feel at home. If you want to learn, you will not find a better place.

  • We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. In healthcare that only works with rigour: tests, small changes, no untested refactoring.

  • We talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the sales team that sells the product. No silos.

Who does well here

  • 2 to 5 years of experience shipping production software, ideally in a startup where you have seen what fast really means.

  • A strong academic background (top engineering school) is a plus. A track record that speaks for itself works just as well.

  • Comfortable in TypeScript and Node. The exact framework matters less than your fundamentals.

  • You know how to scope and cut. Saying no is worth a lot here, because the AI always says yes.

  • You want your work to be used, not just reviewed, and you like seeing the company grow.

Our first engineer arrived with one year of experience. Eighteen months later he was leading a team. We hire on trajectory, and no engineer has left since day one.

What we expect from you

First week

  • Get onboarded on the stack.

  • Ship your first improvement on the dashboard.

First month

  • Own one feature end to end, from the spec with the ops team to production.

First 3 months

  • Ship a piece of the scenario engine or the self-serve onboarding that clinics use in production.

  • Know the product well enough to challenge a spec before building it.

6 to 12 months

  • Own one area of the platform, with the ops team coming to you first.

  • Take part in technical interviews and help the next engineers get onboarded.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

About Sereact

Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex.

The role

This is a Research Engineer position. It is scoped to the data generation layer of the VLA stack: teleoperation hardware and software, retargeting pipelines that map human demonstrations onto robot hands, and the data collection infrastructure that feeds Cortex. It requires building the systems that produce the data those models train on, and working closely with the training team on what that data needs to look like.

jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.


Your mission

Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.


Your profile

The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant: a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title.
  • We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one.
  • Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
  • Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible.
  • Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together.


Process

  1. Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are.
  2. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going.
  3. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves.
  4. Meet the team in our Zurich office.
  5. A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team.

jobs.title: Automations Engineer, Post Sales Systems
jobs.description:
Automations Engineer, Post Sales Systems

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

Job Summary

As a Support Automation Engineer on the Post Sales Systems team, you will design, build, and maintain the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's post-sales support organization. You'll be responsible for translating business workflows in Zendesk and related CX platforms into scalable, intelligent automations that reduce manual effort, improve customer experience, and free up our support team to focus on high-value interactions.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering rigor and customer empathy. You'll partner closely with the Support and Success organizations, GTM Systems Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to automate away toil, surface insights through AI, and build systems that adapt to how support teams actually work. The kind of person who thrives here moves fast, takes full ownership of what they build, and is genuinely excited about applying AI to real operational problems. This role is a direct contributor to GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Powered Automation Design & Development

  • Design and build automations in Zendesk that reduce repetitive support work: ticket routing, field population, note summarization, escalation logic, and customer outreach workflows.

  • Develop AI-driven workflows using Zendesk AI, custom LLM integrations, and ClickUp Super Agents to automate tasks like ticket summarization, sentiment analysis, knowledge base matching, and response suggestions.

  • Architect low-code/no-code automation solutions using Workato, Zapier, and similar integration platforms to connect Zendesk with Salesforce, ClickUp, Maven chatbot, and other tools.

  • Own the full lifecycle of an automation: discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization based on usage and feedback.

CX Systems Integration & Data Flow

  • Ensure seamless data flow between Zendesk, Salesforce, ClickUp, Chili Piper, Maven AGI chatbot, and other tools in the support tech stack.

  • Design integration patterns that keep data clean, up-to-date, and accessible to downstream systems without creating maintenance nightmares.

  • Build and maintain reporting dashboards and data pipelines that surface support health, automation impact, and team productivity metrics.

  • Partner with the Support org to identify pain points, bottlenecks, and opportunities where AI and automation can deliver measurable value.

AI Capability Expansion

  • Experiment with emerging AI/LLM capabilities (agents, RAG, fine-tuning) and determine which are production-ready for support workflows.

  • Build reusable AI templates and patterns that other CX Systems team members can leverage, promoting consistency and reducing duplication.

  • Collaborate with the broader GTM Systems Engineering team to share learnings and align on AI strategy across post-sales, sales, and finance domains.

  • Log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry to promote transparency and cross-team learning.

Reliability & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor automation health, error rates, and SLAs; proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact support operations.

  • Gather feedback from support teams and stakeholders; iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce false positives, and adapt to evolving business needs.

  • Maintain documentation and runbooks so that support and CX teams understand how automations work and when to escalate issues.

  • Help simplify and modernize existing architecture in Zendesk and connecting systems to improve long-term maintainability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with GTM Support teammates and leadership on intake, prioritization, and task execution.

  • Partner with the Support and Success organizations and key stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

  • Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene and communicate proactively on large initiatives.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3–5+ years in systems administration, business systems engineering, or customer support platform work.

  • Demonstrated experience building automations or integrations that have shipped to production and delivered measurable business value.

  • Hands-on experience with CX platforms, particularly Zendesk at an admin level or higher.

  • Experience in a high-velocity, collaborative environment where you wear multiple hats and adapt quickly.

  • Optional but valued: experience with ClickUp, Maven/chatbots, GTM systems, or support-focused SaaS operations.

Skills & Competencies

Technical

  • Zendesk expertise: Hands-on experience with automations, triggers, business rules, and configuration (admin-level proficiency or higher).

  • Integration & API work: Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and integration platforms (Retool, Workato, Zapier, or similar low-code tools).

  • AI & LLMs: Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), MCP, and how to safely integrate AI into production workflows. You don't need to be an ML engineer, but you should understand when and how to apply AI to solve real problems.

  • Data & scripting: Comfortable working with JSON, SQL, or light scripting (Python, JavaScript) to build data pipelines and transform data between systems.

  • Salesforce integration: Understanding of Zendesk-to-Salesforce sync workflows, object relationships, and common integration patterns.

Operational & Mindset

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build—reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement included. You don't hand off and walk away.

  • Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You embrace "done is better than perfect" when appropriate, but never at the expense of reliability or customer trust.

  • AI & Automation mindset: You're excited about LLMs and AI agents, not intimidated. You experiment, learn quickly, and know when to apply new tools and when to stick with what works.

  • Collaboration: You're a skilled communicator who can translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. You ask clarifying questions, challenge assumptions respectfully, and build trust with the teams you support.

  • Growth: You're customer-centric and measure success not just by automation coverage, but by the real impact on support efficiency and quality.

What You'll Work With

  • Zendesk: Primary CX platform—automations, triggers, custom fields, custom apps, and reporting.

  • ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem.

  • Salesforce: Zendesk-to-Salesforce integration, data sync, field mapping, and cross-system workflows.

  • Integration stack: Workato, Zapier, and possibly Retool for custom apps and workflow orchestration.

  • Maven chatbot & AI tools: In-app support, ticket automation, and AI-driven customer interactions.

  • Data & reporting: ClickUp, Salesforce dashboards, and custom data pipelines for support metrics and insights.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (TypeScript, Backend‑Heavy)
jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer (TypeScript, Backend‑Heavy)

We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech. REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. The result: life‑saving medical devices reach patients faster and safer.

About the job

As a Principal Software Engineer, Platform, you’ll build the services, workflows, and developer-facing APIs behind our AI requirements engine, document processing pipelines, and compliance workflows used by leading MedTech companies.

You’ll work closely with product, domain experts, and data teams to turn complex regulatory requirements into reliable, intuitive product experiences. Because we operate in a highly regulated industry, correctness, traceability, and reliability are central to how we build.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

How you’ll contribute

We are not looking for someone to just complete tickets. We want a partner in decision‑making (product and tech) who takes ownership, challenges assumptions, and drives initiatives.

In this role, you will combine deep technical ownership with hands‑on contribution:

  • Shape the technical roadmap – Partner with product and founders to define, refine, and prioritize our technical roadmap.

  • Drive architecture & design – Lead architectural decisions for our backend and services, ensuring they are secure, extensible, and compliant.

  • Build and ship features end‑to‑end – Design, develop, and deploy scalable web applications and APIs (backend‑heavy, with the ability to contribute to React frontends where needed).

  • Tackle complex engineering problems – Lead the way on difficult technical decisions while continuously improving our practices, processes, and quality/security standards. Unblock others on their challenges as well by helping debug tricky issues, reviewing designs, and sharing context so the team can move faster.

  • Collaborate across disciplines – Work closely with machine learning, product, and design to discover and ship solutions that truly solve customer problems.

Our stack

We work in a modern TypeScript‑first monorepo:

  • Core: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5+, pnpm workspaces, Turborepo.

  • Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, and design system.

  • Backend & workflows: Express-based services, with DBOS for durable workflows.

  • Data & storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma ORM, Azure Blob Storage.

  • AI & observability: Azure OpenAI, Langfuse, Sentry, plus logging/tracing with tools like Winston and OpenTelemetry.

  • Dev experience: AI‑assisted workflows with Cursor and Claude Code, integrated into our TypeScript‑first monorepo and review process.

What you’ll bring

  • You’ve solved complex problems in production – e.g. scaling bottlenecks, reliability issues, tricky data/architecture trade-offs.

  • Strong TypeScript + Node.js backend experience in larger codebases, with a focus on building and operating production services.

  • Solid database fundamentals – PostgreSQL (ideally) including data modelling, migrations, and performance.

  • Experience with distributed patterns – event-driven communication, workflows, or loosely coupled services is a strong plus.

  • Cloud + containers – hands-on with Docker and/or Kubernetes and at least one major cloud provider (Azure is a plus).

  • Backend-heavy full-stack comfort – you can contribute to React when needed, but your depth is on platform/backend.

  • High quality bar, pragmatic mindset – you ship maintainable, well-tested systems in compliance-heavy environments and use AI tools (Cursor/Claude Code) as leverage without compromising reliability.

Why this is a great opportunity

  • Impact in a high-stakes domain – Work on compliance workflows in one of the most regulated industries, where correctness and traceability matter and the outcomes are real.

  • Bring GenAI into production – Build the systems that make LLM-driven features predictable, auditable, and reliable in safety-critical MedTech environments.

  • Real ownership – Own major parts of our platform and drive architectural decisions across backend services, workflows, and data.

  • AI‑agent‑first development – Build in an environment where tools like Cursor and Claude Code are first‑class citizens, helping you explore designs, refactor, and ship faster while you stay in control of quality and reliability.

  • Strong peers – Work with people who care deeply about craft and outcomes, in a high-ownership culture that includes teammates with founder experience.

  • Work with leading MedTech companies – Build products used by teams at BBraun, Novartis & Bayer.

Praktikant Business Building & AI Automation (m/w/d) – Digital Education mit Impact
Über uns – Talentspring Academy Group

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht?

Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss, während gleichzeitig ganze Branchen durch KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle transformiert werden. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.

Die Talentspring Academy Group baut eine neue Generation von Bildungsplattformen für die Arbeitswelt von morgen. Wir qualifizieren Arbeitssuchende, Quereinsteiger:innen und Beschäftigte für gefragte Tätigkeiten in Bereichen wie Online Marketing, Digital Sales und Künstliche Intelligenz.

Mit unserem hybriden Modell aus digitaler Plattform und physischer Infrastruktur – über 900 Standorte bundesweit durch unseren Partner Studienkreis – schaffen wir eine neue Kategorie im deutschen Weiterbildungsmarkt.

Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei?


Über die Rolle

Als Praktikant Business Building & AI Automation baust du die internen Systeme, mit denen unsere Organisation skaliert: Tools, Datenstrecken und Automatisierungen, die Arbeit übernehmen, die heute noch Menschen erledigen.

Du arbeitest im Venture-Building-Team und berichtest direkt an unseren CEO. Wir sind builders within: ein Team, das im Unternehmen selbst baut – interne Produkte, Systeme und neue Geschäftsmodelle – statt Konzepte für andere zu schreiben. Du kommst also nicht als einzelne Automatisierungskraft in eine Fachabteilung, sondern in eine Gruppe, die dasselbe Handwerk betreibt wie du.

Unsere Sales-Organisation umfasst aktuell 30 Personen und wächst schnell. Parallel entwickeln wir eine HubSpot-basierte CRM-Architektur, neue B2B-Strukturen und eine datengetriebene Marketing- und Sales Engine. Genau in diesem Umbau setzt deine Arbeit an.

Eng zusammen arbeitest du mit Infrastruktur & Data. Die Rolle liegt an der Schnittstelle von:

  • Marketing und Sales
  • Operations und Akademie
  • CRM und Tech Stack
  • Data und Analytics
  • Venture Building und neue Geschäftsmodelle

Kurz gesagt: Du baust an unserem internen Betriebssystem – und setzt selbst um, was du entworfen hast. Für reine Strategie- oder Analystenarbeit ist die Rolle nicht gedacht: Hier wird gebaut, eingeführt und gemessen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Process Intelligence & Automation: Du durchleuchtest Abläufe in Marketing, Sales, Operations und Akademie, bewertest sie nach Aufwand, Häufigkeit und wirtschaftlichem Hebel und automatisierst die Prozesse mit dem größten Effekt.
  • Internal Tools & Rapid Prototyping: Du baust mit KI- und No-Code-Werkzeugen (z. B. n8n, KI-Agenten) interne Anwendungen und Prototypen, testest sie direkt im laufenden Betrieb und übernimmst Rollout, Dokumentation und Einweisung der Teams.
  • AI Workflows: Du bringst KI über den Prototypenstatus hinaus: Anfragen priorisieren, Gespräche auswerten, Chancen und Risiken erkennen, operative Arbeit übernehmen. Was funktioniert, wird zum verlässlichen internen Produkt.
  • Data, KPI & Reporting: Du führst Daten aus unseren Systemen zusammen, definierst Kennzahlen entlang der Growth Engine – von Leadgenerierung über Funnel bis Enrollment – und baust die Grundlagen für datenbasierte Entscheidungen im Management.

jobs.title: Brand Content Specialist (gn)
jobs.description:
Brand Content Specialist (gn)

Join the “Testsieger” – the fastest growing frozen pizza company in Germany and best frozen pizza out of 21 frozen pizza brands according to Stiftung Warentest!

Freda is looking for a Brand Content Specialist directly reporting to the Head of Marketing to bring our brand to life through cut-through content people want to watch, share and engage with.

You’ll be the creative force behind our social-first brand storytelling, from developing ideas and recurring formats, capturing what happens behind the scenes at Freda, jumping on trends and turning our products, people and story into compelling content.

This is a hands-on role from start to finish. You’ll come up with concepts, shoot them, get in front of the camera when needed and edit everything into great content. From a spontaneous iPhone video to a recurring Freda content series or a performance ad, you know how to turn an idea into something that stops the scroll.

If you live and breathe social content, love food and storytelling and want a lot of creative ownership in a fast-growing brand, we’d love to hear from you.

Aufgaben

  • Create content from idea to final edit: Concept, shoot and edit social-first video and photo content for Instagram, TikTok and other relevant channels. You’re hands-on throughout the entire process and comfortable working independently with an iPhone or camera.
  • Build Freda stories & formats: Develop recurring content series and recognizable formats that give people a reason to follow Freda beyond our products. Think BTS, team and founders, product stories, launches, retail moments, taste tests and everything else happening around the Freda world.
  • Be behind and in front of the camera: You’re comfortable shooting and directing others, but equally happy jumping in front of the camera yourself when the idea calls for it.
  • Create content for ads: Work closely with Performance Marketing to develop scroll-stopping paid social creative. Come up with new hooks, concepts and angles, produce different creative iterations and use performance learnings to make the next ad better.
  • Own our day-to-day social presence: Help shape how Freda shows up across Instagram and TikTok, from planned content to spontaneous ideas and trends.
  • Stay close to social culture: Know what people are watching, talking about and sharing. Spot trends, formats and conversations and find ways to make them unmistakably Freda rather than simply following what everyone else is doing.
  • Build our community: Engage with our audience through comments and DMs, spark conversations and help turn customers and followers into genuine Freda fans.
  • Learn from what works: Track how content performs, identify patterns and translate those learnings into better concepts, hooks and formats.

Qualifikation

  • Experience creating social-first content for Instagram and TikTok (even if it’s just on your personal accounts). We care more about what you can create than a specific number of years on your CV.
  • Strong video creation and editing skills. You can take an idea from concept through shooting to a polished final edit.
  • A deep understanding of social media trends. Memes, challenges, music, and everything in between.
  • Confidence behind and in front of the camera. You enjoy working with people on camera and are comfortable becoming part of the content yourself.
  • A good instinct for storytelling and formats. You don't just think post by post – you can see how an idea could become a recurring series or recognizable Freda format.
  • A passion for community building. You're approachable, responsive, and excited to engage with Freda’s fanbase.
  • Experience or interest in creating content for ads.
  • A hands-on, resourceful mindset. You don't need a large production setup to make great content happen.
  • A love for food - whether it’s pizza or Frozen Blocks. If it’s delicious, you’re into it!
  • You speak the language: You speak our customers’ and team’s language. Therefore, fluency in German and English is a must.

Benefits

  • A successful and growing company: Join a growth company that has just raised a Seed round and it’s been nominated “Testsieger” - best frozen pizza in Germany!
  • Awesome team: Work directly with experienced marketers and our founders in a dynamic and international team
  • Future of food: Be part of building the future of frozen convenience food in e-commerce and retail.
  • Start-up culture: Start-up culture that values direct and transparent communication, a fast-paced environment, and personal development. With Freda, you can make a real impact
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a beautiful and central office in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, flexible working hours, and numerous benefits.

We look forward to receiving your application. Creative applications are very welcomed.

Founding Account Executive

What do we do?

Our mission is to radically accelerate the pace of software development by empowering every engineer to ship at the speed their agents write code. We’re building the last piece of the puzzle to enable this - the part that makes it actually safe to ship.

AI is enabling engineers to write code faster than ever before. But software review and testing hasn’t caught up. Engineering leaders are drowning in long software review cycles and more bugs than ever. The bottleneck isn’t writing code anymore, it’s everything that comes after it.

We spent 3 years building patented foundational technology to solve this. Our CTO, Quentin, spent over a decade at Palantir, where he led the 0 to 1 of core products that insiders credit as the primary value drivers behind Gotham and Foundry. Since then, we’ve grown 5x year-on-year and now work with top engineering orgs - Notion, ElevenLabs, Mercor, Dropbox, Discord, LaunchDarkly, Wiz, CoreWeave, Wealthsimple, and more.

You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time. We’ve raised $20m from Chemistry, Menlo and Coatue, the same investors behind Twilio, Twitch, Intercom and PagerDuty and are backed by angels including the founders of Vercel, Datadog, Segment, Dropbox, the CTO of GitHub, CPO of Adobe, head of engineering at Cursor and many more.

This is an opportunity to join a company going through hypergrowth as we scale from millions of annual recurring revenue to $100m ARR.

If this excites you, come help us build it!

What is the opportunity?

Join us as a Founding AE hire in London and own the full sales motion end-to-end, from first discovery to strategising pilot deployment to closing the deal.

Most AEs work a narrow slice of the stack, repeating the same sales scripts and motion deal after deal and handing off to a sales engineer the moment a conversation turns technical. Here, you’ll own the sales cycle from discovery to pilot, then stay on as deployment lead to make sure it actually succeeds. You’ll own technical conversations, building real technical authority with engineering leaders and understand exactly what their software development workflow looks like, why they buy and what they’d like to see different about the product.

This is an IC role, there is no team beneath you and no one to delegate work to.

Examples of what you will work on

  • Own end-to-end cycles: You’ll build and manage your own sales pipeline, win pilots and close deals, growing to lead a geography or sector or team as we scale

  • Lead enterprise sales: Navigate complex sales cycles with the world’s leading mid-market and enterprise tech businesses (up to $XXX BN market cap), initially securing low-six then mid-six figure deals

  • Strategise complex deployments: Work alongside our engineers on pilots to figure out how to make them successful, run training sessions and build strong relationships at the user level

  • Help steer our roadmap: You’ll become the best person in the company at explaining and pitching the product and can take specific customer feedback back to our product teams

  • Events: You’ll network with CTOs & engineering leaders, attend our dinners and conferences across the US, and become well-known in this space

You will love this role if

  • ⭐ You learn fast and want to dive deep into the product - you have strong analytical thinking and can work from first principles; ambiguity / lack of experience in a technical domain doesn’t faze you / you are excited to learn!

  • ⭐ You are highly agentic - you have a bias to action, move fast, take ownership without being asked (e.g. if you need sales collateral you build it yourself!)

  • ⭐ You’re a hunter - chasing down revenue feels energizing, not exhausting or stressful, you create your own pipeline if there isn’t one!

  • ⭐ You want to work with engineers - you will spend most of your time externally and internally with developers, and this excites you!

This role is not for you if

  • You expect to work regular working hours and to travel infrequently; our teams, customers, investors span SF, London, NY

  • You need a team of BDRs, RevOps and Marketing to support you across the sales motion

  • You expect to lean entirely on engineers for technical demos and discovery calls

  • You expect never to have to build your own pipeline

Requirements

  • STEM degree

  • 3-7 years of work experience outperforming in a B2B SaaS sales, strategic deployment or adjacent role

  • Experience with outbound-led sales

  • Bonus if you have experience selling a deeply technical product to senior engineering leaders or have been an early GTM hire (< #20) at a fast growing startup

  • If you were previously or are currently a software engineer with strong commercial acumen looking to pivot into tech sales, we’d strongly encourage you to apply!

You may look like this

  • Ex-STEM: You were always on the STEM track but realised being around people is what drives you! You are currently an AE but want to go back to doing something that is a bit more technical.

  • Builder: You are an AE but were previously a founder, have been part of an incubator (YC, EF, Antler) or want to be a future founder. You spike at commercial work but want to build knowledge outside of that to be a more well rounded leader in the future.

  • Early-stage operator: You have been or want to be an early founding hire to help shape what sales looks like and work to build up the processes, materials and strategy that will help us win!

  • AI lover: You work in b2b sales but feel like AI is developing so quickly you’re being left behind and want to build out a more technical skillset

Perks ♥️

  • Competitive comp + significant equity

  • 🍲 Unlimited food & drinks in office - including daily lunch as a team, and your own Amazon business account to buy whatever snacks you want for the office.

  • 💻 A setup you’ll love - everyone has a standing desk, brand new Macbook, your choice of ergonomic peripherals, and a £2k WFH budget to make home just as good

  • 🏄‍♀️ £300 monthly wellness stipend - Third Space gym, reformer pilates, cold plunge, however you want to keep your best

  • 🎁 We celebrate you - £400 in gifts on your birthday and work anniversary every year

  • 🌴 Team offsites - we work and play hard, we’ve done offsites in Italy, Abu Dhabi and local 5-star resorts

  • 📚 Unlimited book budget - we have a growing in-office library and actively encourage everyone to add to it, whether you want to ramp up your knowledge of software testing, or become a better startup operator!

People behind Meticulous

Guillermo Rauch (founder of Vercel), Jason Warner (CTO of GitHub), Calvin French-Owen (founder of Segment), Jared Friedman (YC partner and founder of Scribd), Scott Belsky (CPO of Adobe), Arash Ferdowsi (founder of Dropbox) and many others are all personal investors in Meticulous.

jobs.title: Risk and Controls Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Risk and Controls Operations Associate

Risk and Controls Operations Associate

Office Location: Temple, London - hybrid working environment (3 days in office per week)

Reporting: Chief Operating Officer

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that.

So far, we have raised £3.5 million in funding, secured direct regulatory approval from the FCA, and picked up two major awards in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) and Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN). Having launched on iOS - reaching 4,000+ total sign-ups - we have now just launched on Android, doubling our addressable market as we scale toward targets of 10,000 users, 100,000, and beyond.

Key Platform Traction:

  • 8,000+ trades processed

  • 2,500+ early supporters rewarded for their loyalty

  • 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • 150+ 5-star reviews

Our goal is straightforward: Think Options, Think Investa.

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

The Role

As our Risk & Controls Operations Associate, you will serve as the first line of regulatory and operational control for Investa’s platform. Working together with our Head of Risk & Compliance and Co-Founders, you will help own the day-to-day execution of our key operational controls spanning CASS oversight, onboarding operations, financial crime monitoring, and execution control.

This is a critical, high-visibility role within a fast-scaling financial trading environment. You will bridge regulatory oversight with practical execution: verifying client money flows, resolving dealing and onboarding exceptions, and ensuring our operations adhere strictly to FCA standards as our operating model expands from sub-account clearing into in-house custody.

What the role involves

1. Risk & Control Operations

  • CASS Reconciliations: Perform daily internal & external CASS reconciliations across Investa’s client base to prevent breaches and ensure compliance with day-to-day CASS obligations.

  • CASS Reporting & Audits: Maintain audit-ready compliance records, log breaks and CASS breaches, and assist in preparing regulatory returns and notifications when needed.

  • KYC & Onboarding Operations: Own the day-to-day onboarding queue, performing KYC/AML document reviews, appropriateness assessments, and managing PEPs, sanctions, and high-risk escalations.

  • Financial Crime Monitoring: Organise high-risk client reviews assisting with enhanced due diligence, source of funds/wealth checks, and periodic and event driven reviews.

  • Vulnerable Customer Framework: Manage sensitive customer cases as identified in the vulnerable clients policy, ensure good outcomes for clients with support needs, manage key performance indicators for clients in this segment in strict compliance with Consumer Duty standards and internal policies.

2. Business Oversight & Governance Support

  • Management Information: Own and gather key performance indicators covering all aspects of the business for committee reporting and oversight.

  • Financial Promotions: Review and approve marketing campaigns, product copy, and social media promotions to ensure strict alignment with FCA Financial Promotion and Consumer Duty rules.

  • Regulatory Change: Assist in implementation of regulatory change in the UK or elsewhere to ensure compliance with new rules that apply to the Firm.

  • Third Party Risk Management: Point of contact for vendors and outsourcing partners to oversee and coordinate information sharing for incident closure & customer support.

  • Trade surveillance: Provide first line review of alerts generated through trade surveillance for signs of market abuse. Oversee the closure of alerts and applicable audit trail.

Your Background

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
Founding Product Manager

Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

Product at Lemrock has been driven by the founders so far. As our first Product Manager, you'll work directly with the founders and our CTO to shape the product vision, own a core part of the product end to end, and build the practice that takes us from idea to shipped.

You'll start by owning the brand-facing product, and your scope will grow fast from there.

Your mission

  • Shape the vision: bring your own conviction to the product strategy with the founders, from what we bet on next to what we stop doing.

  • Own the roadmap end to end: turn strategy into a living, prioritized roadmap, and decide what we don't build so the team stays on the highest-impact work.

  • Run discovery: spend real time with brands, partners and the field, find the problems worth solving, and validate before we build.

  • Ship with the team: work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to scope, prototype, and ship weekly, not quarterly.

  • Own launches and outcomes: drive rollout, watch the data, onboard the business teams, and judge your work by what it moved, not by what shipped.

  • Build the product function itself: the rituals, the prioritization, the feedback loop from the field.

What we're looking for

  • 3 to 8 years in product, at least part of it at a startup or scale-up, ideally as an early or first PM. You've taken something from a vague problem to a shipped, used feature, and owned its results.

  • A generalist comfortable owning the messy middle: discovery one hour, scoping with engineers the next, writing the launch note after that.

  • A bias for action: you make calls with incomplete data, ship, and iterate from what real users do.

  • Customer obsession that shows up in your decisions.

  • AI-native: you already build with tools like Claude, Cursor, v0 or Lovable to prototype, research, synthesize, and move the roadmap faster.

  • Able to learn a lot, fast, in a deep and complex environment.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Based in Paris, with the team at the office (up to 1 day remote per week).

Bonus

  • You've built in e-commerce, marketplaces, adtech, or AI/agent products, or you're genuinely fascinated by agentic commerce.

  • A technical background (ex-software engineer or CS), so you can go deep with the team and direct AI tools effectively.

Why join us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue with a clear edge.

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic commerce.

  • Work directly with experienced, ambitious founders, and own the product from day one.

  • Shape both the product and how we build it.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary, based on experience

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Meal vouchers with Swile

  • Alan health insurance

  • 7 weeks of vacation (RTT included)

  • 50% transportation coverage

jobs.title: Founder Associate to the CEO - End-of-studies internship (2K€/month, Paris, January 2027)
jobs.description:
Founder Associate to the CEO - End-of-studies internship (2K€/month, Paris, January 2027)

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, and free up time for medical teams. Following our $20M Series A, we are a team of 50+ across Paris and New York, and 250 healthcare organizations use Vocca.

Eliott (CEO) and Hugo (CTO) have more topics to open than time to work on them: the US launch, new verticals, new countries, a finance function to structure. Maxime, our Chief of Staff, turns their priorities into projects, and his own scope is growing fast.

We are opening a Founder Associate internship to give them leverage. You report to Maxime and work on the founders' priorities, in daily contact with the three of them. The role is open to business and engineering profiles.

Your mission

Take on the topics Eliott and Hugo cannot dig into themselves and bring each one to a result they can use: a quantified recommendation they can decide on, a model or a process the team works with, or an experiment with measured results.

Expected outcomes

After 1 month:

  • You know the product, our customers and how each team works, in France and in the US

  • You have delivered a first project from start to finish, scoped with Maxime

After 3 months:

  • The US sales team works from a target account list you built from our usage data, with the enablement material that goes with it

  • You have presented a first quantified market study to the founders (a new vertical or a new country): sizing, segmentation and a go or no-go recommendation

  • The Chief of Staff team uses a financial model you built, on unit economics or on an expansion scenario

After 6 months:

  • You run two or three recurring topics on your own

  • You have designed and run at least one growth experiment, from hypothesis to a statistical reading of the results, with a recommendation to scale or stop

  • At least one of your recommendations has become a company decision

What you will work on

You cannot list everything a Founder Associate does. This is what your day-to-day looks like.

Market exploration

  • Run quantified studies on new verticals and new countries: market sizing, segmentation, go-to-market modeling

  • Run product and competitive benchmarks

  • Bring structured recommendations back to the founders

Growth and US sales enablement

  • Design growth experiments and measure them: hypotheses, metrics, statistical reading of the results

  • Build target account and call lists for the US team from our usage data

  • Produce the enablement material the sales team needs

Finance structuring

  • Build financial models with Maxime: unit economics, expansion scenarios, sensitivity to pricing assumptions

  • Build the reports used to steer the company

  • Run the analyses the founders need to make a decision

Public affairs

  • Follow the regulation of AI in healthcare and the public debate around it, and flag what affects us

  • Map the public bodies, health authorities and professional organizations that matter for Vocca, in France and in the US

  • Prepare the founders' meetings with them: briefs, position notes, follow-ups

Founder branding

  • Make Eliott and Hugo known and listened to in two communities: the healthcare professionals who buy Vocca, and the talent we want to hire

  • Run their content with them: LinkedIn posts, talks, events

  • Track what works with each audience and adjust

Ops playbook, depending on your profile

Depending on what you thrive in, business, engineering or something else, you can also take ownership of pieces of our Ops playbook: the process by which we deploy a voice agent in a new clinic, from configuration to go-live.

  • Map each step and instrument it with the right data

  • Find where time and quality are lost

  • Redesign the process so it scales from hundreds to thousands of sites without growing the team at the same rate

Beyond this list

Depending on what you are good at and what you want to learn, you will pick up other topics: recruiting, internal operations, internal communication.

This role is for you if

Requirements:

  • You are in your final year at a top-tier engineering or business school and looking for a 6-month end-of-studies internship starting in January 2027

  • You have already built something: you ran a student society, launched a project, or worked in a demanding environment such as a startup, a bank or a consulting firm

  • You are fluent in French and English

What we will assess:

  • You understand fast, and you can turn a vague question into a structured answer with a recommendation

  • You have strong business sense. You will work with the founders and Maxime every day

  • You are at ease with numbers and data: you can build a model, size a market and read the results of an experiment

  • You are very autonomous and organized. You manage up: you say what you need, raise blockers early and follow up without being asked

  • You are entrepreneurial. You know the startup world, you love tech, and you want to start a company one day

  • You are AI literate and understand how an AI product works

  • You break silos: you move easily between teams in Paris and New York

  • You keep asking how you could do better and have more impact

Nice to have: programming notions, which help on the Ops playbook.

This role is NOT for you if

  • You want a fixed scope. Your topics will change with the company's priorities

  • You only want to work on strategy. A good part of the job is execution: building models and lists, running experiments, keeping a report up to date

  • You need close supervision to move forward

After the internship

We built this internship as a way into Vocca. If it goes well, we want you to stay full time, in a role we define together based on what you did best.

Compensation and benefits

  • €2,000 gross per month

  • 6-month end-of-studies internship (convention de stage), starting January 2027

  • Based at our Paris office (2nd arrondissement), with possible trips to our New York office paid by the company

  • MacBook provided

  • Meal vouchers and 50% of your Navigo pass covered

  • Annual offsite and team events throughout the year

Hiring process

  1. Video call with our Talent Acquisition team (30 min)

  2. Video interview with Maxime, Chief of Staff (30 min)

  3. On-site business case with Maxime (1h)

  4. On-site meeting with Eliott, CEO, and/or Hugo, CTO, followed by a coffee with the team (1h)

  5. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - F/H
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - F/H

Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu prends la main sur un périmètre produit à fort enjeu business. Tu analyses les processus en place, tu identifies les leviers d'amélioration réels et tu formalises une vision produit et une feuille de route alignées sur les priorités métier.

  • Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus.

  • Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre.

  • Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment.

  • Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes.

  • Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi.

  • Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l'ambition, l'expertise et l'apprentissage.

Le package : 44.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.


Pré-requis du poste

👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager ou Product Owner sur des produits digitaux, dont une expérience significative en écosystème complexe : plusieurs métiers, plusieurs systèmes, des décisions qui ne se prennent jamais seul.

  • Tu sais mener un sujet produit de la discovery aux critères d'acceptation, et tu as déjà porté une vision et une feuille de route face à des parties prenantes exigeantes.

  • Ta maturité data est réelle : tu interprètes toi-même les chiffres, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider.

  • Tu es à l'aise pour contribuer au cadrage fonctionnel de briques applicatives structurantes, sans y perdre ta hauteur de vue produit.

  • Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une posture conseil assumée, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve. Anglais professionnel.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

  • Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l'adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

  • Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

  • Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

  • Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d'embauche

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.

  • Fluent German and very good English, both written and spoken

  • Genuine technical depth. Working knowledge of AI and Inference, cloud infrastructure, and how modern software gets deployed and operated, with awareness of the Kubernetes ecosystem.

  • Writing you did yourself. You ship copy.
  • Comfort with speed and ambiguity. Our releases ship in weeks. The AI infrastructure market is moving quickly.
  • Trust with engineers, and senior sales leaders.

A plus if you…

  • Direct experience marketing AI or ML infrastructure, including inference serving, GPU capacity, or MLOps.
  • Fluency in the CNCF and/or PyTorch ecosystem
  • Hyperscaler or cloud marketplace route-to-market experience (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Training in a value messaging discipline such as Command of the Message, or an equivalent framework you have actually operationalized.
  • You have been the first or only PMM on a product and built the function from nothing.

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.
