jobs.title: IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering (m/w/d)
Die Albert Schweitzer Stiftung für unsere Mitwelt sucht

IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering (m/w/d)

zum nächstmöglichen Termin in Berlin (hoher Homeoffice-Anteil möglich) mit 35 Wochenstunden (Vollzeit) in Festanstellung.


Unsere Vision ist eine Welt, in der kein Tier mehr für die Herstellung von Lebensmitteln leidet. Unsere Mission lautet: Gemeinsam Tierschutzstandards erhöhen und den Verbrauch von Tierprodukten senken. Mit unserer Arbeit wirken wir in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, Recht und Politik. Auf allen Ebenen gehen wir mit den jeweiligen Akteur:innen praktikable Schritte in Richtung eines respektvollen Umgangs mit den Tieren und erleichtern auch vermeintlichen Gegner:innen den Ausstieg aus bisherigen Handlungsmustern.


Als IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering wirst du Teil unseres bislang zweiköpfigen IT-Teams, das mit einem reibungslosen, effizienten und sicheren Betrieb von IT-Infrastruktur und Online-Auftritten dafür sorgt, dass unsere Arbeit ihre maximale Wirkung entfalten kann.  


Das bewirkst du bei uns

Du legst das technische Fundament, auf dem die gesamte Arbeit der Albert Schweitzer Stiftung für unsere Mitwelt aufbaut, und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig, sicher und zukunftsfähig bleiben.

Als IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering bist du verantwortlich für die Konzeption, Planung und Umsetzung der Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Infrastruktur und -Anwendungslandschaft: Du betreust unsere Hosting-Infrastruktur in der Cloud und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter, sorgst dafür, dass zentrale Systeme wie CRM, Spendenplattform, Webseiten, Kampagnen und Mailing-Infrastruktur reibungslos miteinander Daten austauschen, und entwickelst dafür auch individuelle Softwarelösungen.


Im Einzelnen bedeutet das

  • Du betreust, entwickelst und integrierst sowohl unsere bestehenden als auch neu einzuführende IT-Systeme, wie auch unsere DevOps-Plattform, zum Beispiel GitHub und AWS, weiter. 

  • Du konzipierst, implementierst, dokumentierst und rollst neue IT-Projekte & Lösungen aus.

  • Du stehst im engen Austausch mit Kolleg:innen im IT-Team und in anderen Fachbereichen und berätst zu fachlichen wie nicht-fachlichen Anforderungen, etwa IT-Sicherheit oder Usability.

  • Du unterstützt und berätst die Fachbereiche bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von IT-Lösungen – von der Einschätzung technischer Machbarkeit und Aufwand über die technische Umsetzung bis hin zur Auswahl geeigneter Off-the-Shelf-Komponenten.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie im Betrieb moderner Anwendungs- und Plattform-Infrastrukturen (z. B. Cloud/PaaS, CI/CD, Integrationen).

  • Im Bereich DevOps und IT-Infrastruktur bringst du herausragende Erfahrung mit.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwareentwicklung (vorzugsweise PHP/Laravel) und der Integration von Anwendungen per REST oder GraphQL APIs

  • Für die Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen beherrschst du HTML, (S)CSS und Javascript/Typescript und hast auch Erfahrung in der Anpassung von PHP-basierten CMS-Systemen wie Kirby und Statamic.

  • Du bist in der Lage, ein IT-Projekt von Anfang bis Ende zu planen, durchzuführen und zu Ende zu bringen.

  • Dabei arbeitest du zusammen mit fachlichen Stakeholdern, von der Anforderungsanalyse über iterative Checkpoints bis zum Rollout .

  • Du nutzt KI-Systeme, um deine eigene Arbeit zu unterstützen, und kannst anderen dabei helfen, KI für ihre Ziele sinnvoll einzusetzen.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung von Arbeitsabläufen sind gefragt, mit KI-Tooling, Low-Code/No-Code-Plattformen oder klassisch per Scripting. 

  • Du hast gute Kenntnisse in IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Du kennst dich aus im Bereich Identitätsmanagement (IAM) per OAuth oder SAML.

  • Du bist team- und kommunikationsfähig und arbeitest serviceorientiert sowie selbständig.

  • Mit deiner herausragenden Problemlösungskompetenz gehst du auch komplexe technische Herausforderungen sicher an.

  • Auch wenn es mal stressig wird, weil z. B. eine Deadline näher rückt, bleibst du konzentriert.

  • Deutsch und Englisch sprichst du verhandlungssicher (C1-Niveau).

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen – auch wenn nicht alle an einem Ort sind.

  • Du identifizierst dich mit unserer Vision, Mission und Kultur.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeit-Stelle auf 35-Basis: Als Teil des IT-Teams bewirkst du direkt gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und verbesserst den Tierschutz.

  • Home-Office-Möglichkeiten: Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung und arbeitest mit flexiblen, familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten im hybriden Modell (Homeoffice & Büro).

  • Professionelles Team: Kollegialer, offener Austausch in einem motivierten Team 

  • Hundefreundliche Büros inkl. „hundefreie“ Bereiche für Allergiker:innen sowie ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Unbefristet, Jahresgehalt zwischen 48.940,20 und 59.243,40 Euro (erfahrungsbasiert) + Bonuszahlungen 

  • Benefits: Cafeteria-Modell (finanzielle Vorteile, Deutschlandticket oder zusätzliche Urlaubstage), Zuschüsse zu Gesundheitsleistungen (z. B. B12 + D Bluttests) und betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Weiterbildung: Aktive Förderung von Fort- und Weiterbildungen


Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?

Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung bis zum 31.10.2026 per Bewerbungsbutton. Wir möchten von dir erfahren, was dich motiviert, bei der Albert Schweitzer Stiftung zu arbeiten, weshalb du die beste Person für diese Rolle bist und wann du bei uns anfangen könntest. 


Solltest du nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, ermutigen wir dich trotzdem, dich zu bewerben - wir sind auf der Suche nach einer lernfähigen und motivierten Person, die in unser Team passt.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass vielfältige Perspektiven Entscheidungen verbessern können und begrüßen daher ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von Menschen verschiedener Hintergründe.


Bei Fragen zu der Stelle melde dich gerne bei Marie Mittermeier an .

With a strong team of now around 90 employees and over 10,000 users, we are changing an industry whose processes are often still manual, complex, and time-consuming. We are doing this with modern technology and real added value.

To place our rapid growth on a solid financial foundation, we are looking for a Chief of Staff with a focus on Finance (m/f/d) who reports directly to our CEO. In this role, you are a key sparring partner for the management team and an absolute doer. You proactively take responsibility for complex financial topics and the management of important strategic initiatives to ensure that our internal processes keep pace with our scaling.


Your mission

  • Independent project management & execution: You take ownership of strategic growth and financial topics and drive them from conception to successful implementation – always with the goal of making Impower more efficient and data-driven.

  • Strategy & Operations Support: Beyond finance, you support the CEO and the broader management team on internal strategy, optimization, and operational topics. This includes preparing high-impact internal and external presentations and conducting in-depth market analyses.

  • Business Planning & Analytics: You are our Master of Numbers. You independently build financial models, create business plans, forecasts, and in-depth ad-hoc analyses, which you proactively translate into clear recommendations for action.

  • Professionalization of the accounting process: As we grow, our requirements increase. You analyze the status quo, optimize our accounting processes, and elevate our workflows to a highly professional, scalable level, leveraging state of the art technology.

  • OKRs & QBRs: You are responsible for the introduction and tracking of the OKR process as well as the preparation and moderation of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

  • KPIs & Transparency: You are responsible for tracking our key SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, CAC/LTV, Magic Number, Rule of 40, Lead Times, etc.) and regularly exchange ideas with the team leads on these topics. You generate new insights and independently ensure that management can steer the company based on facts at all times.


Your profile

  • Digital & AI affinity: You are highly tech-savvy, experienced with modern digital tools, and actively know how to leverage AI to optimize workflows and increase efficiency.

Why us?

Principal of backend

About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal

This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead

Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

The Technical Challenge

Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:

  • .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
  • TypeScript services.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Cloudflare platform services.
  • API-first architecture.
  • Git-based development workflows.

We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do

You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:

  • Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
  • Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
  • Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
  • Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
  • Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
  • Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
  • Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
  • Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to implementation when that's genuinely the best way to help.
  • Be a generally awesome person.

What We're Looking For

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in modern backend engineering and strong commercial C#/.NET experience.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
  • Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
  • Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
  • Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
  • A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
  • The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
  • Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:

"What's the right solution for us?"

rather than:

"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"

Nice To Have

  • Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
  • Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
  • Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
  • SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.
  • AI-assisted development and engineering productivity tooling.

You don't need to tick every box.

If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year:

  • Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
  • Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.
  • Technical discussions are constructive, pragmatic and result in clear decisions.
  • Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.
  • We've made sensible progress modernising our platform without adding complexity for complexity's sake.
  • You've made a lasting positive impact on both our software and the people who build it.

Ultimately, we don't want SchemeServe to become dependent on you for every difficult technical decision.

We want SchemeServe to become better at making those decisions because you're here.

Why Join SchemeServe?

  • Fully remote UK-based role.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats.
  • Flexible working.
  • Dedicated professional development support.
  • Paid charity days.

Friendly, supportiv...

Product Marketing Manager

About Gladia

Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer.

Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR, across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.

Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).

Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group.

We're guided by four values:

  • Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

The role

Gladia sells to very different buyers — from developers at AI startups to product and engineering leaders at large voice platforms such as contact centers. We need one clear, sharp story for each of them, and the tools that help our sales team tell it.

And our portfolio is growing. Since joining OVH Groupe, we're expanding our product offering which means more products to position and new product lines to bring to market. We need an experienced Product Marketing Manager to help us position each of them and launch them successfully.

As our first Product Marketing Manager, you'll own how Gladia is positioned and how we win. You'll define our messaging by segment, equip our sales team with what they need to close, orchestrate our product launches, and build a real understanding of our market, competitors, and buyers.

You'll report to our Marketing Lead, with a strong dotted line to Product, and you'll work hand in hand with our Sales team: you'll be close to what we build and why, and you'll bring the voice of the market back into product decisions. Day-to-day, you'll work with AEs, SDRs, RevOps, Product, and Marketing.


What you'll do

  • Positioning & messaging — Define Gladia's positioning and messaging for each customer segment, and keep it consistent across sales, marketing, and product

  • Market & user research — Lead market analysis (including TAM sizing) and take part in product and customer interviews, so our positioning and roadmap are grounded in real market insight

  • Sales enablement — Build the materials our sales team uses every day: battlecards, one-pagers, objection handling, pitch narratives, and outbound sequence content

  • Product launches — Own the go-to-market for product launches, from positioning to launch plan, working across Product, Marketing, and Sales — including writing the key launch content yourself (e.g., the launch blog post)

  • Competitive intelligence — Track the competitive landscape and turn it into clear, usable insights for the team

  • Win/loss analysis — Set up a structured process to learn from the deals we win and lose, and feed those learnings back into messaging, product, and sales

  • Buyer personas — Refine our understanding of our buyers: who they are, what they care about, and how they decide

Who you are

  • 5+ years in product marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS, API, or infrastructure companies

  • A track record of building positioning and sales enablement that sales teams actually use

  • Experience running product launches end-to-end

  • A strong connection with Product: you enjoy working closely with product teams and turning market insight into product input

  • Comfortable with technical products — you can understand an API and explain its value to both technical and business buyers

  • Structured and analytical: you use data from deals, customers, and the market to back your decisions

  • Autonomous, with strong judgment on priorities — you've worked in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

  • Excellent writer and communicator, comfortable writing flagship content such as a launch blog post

  • Fluent English

Bonus points

  • Experience launching new product lines and overseeing GTM launches end-to-end, based on a clear playbook

  • Experience selling to the US market

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (TypeScript) - Platform
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer (TypeScript) - Platform

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

The problem

Every medical centre has its own rules. Who can book what, with which practitioner, at what time, what to do with an urgent case at 6 pm. Today these rules live in prompts and in the heads of our ops team. Each new clinic takes hours of manual work, and the ops team is the bottleneck of our growth.

We are building the platform that removes that bottleneck. A scenario engine where the behaviour of the agent is structured configuration, not free text. A self-serve onboarding where a clinic connects its software and sets itself up. A dashboard where the medical staff stop executing and start supervising: the agent handles the volume, humans check what matters.

This is the difference between selling a service and selling a product. It decides how fast Vocca can grow and how many clinics one ops person can support. The long term vision is simple: a clinic signs, connects its software and is live within days, without a single developer involved. You would be building that.

What you will own

The product and its architecture

  • The architecture of the scenario engine and the configuration model. One product that handles the rules of thousands of medical centres without becoming a swamp.

  • The self-serve onboarding, from the backend to the dashboard. Today a clinic deployment went from days to under an hour thanks to internal tooling. The next step is zero developer ticket on a standard onboarding.

  • The dashboard our clinics use all day. Fast, reliable and clean enough that a medical secretary prefers it to the phone. We take frontend quality seriously and we have just created a product designer role to raise the bar.

  • The technical roadmap of the platform, built with the product manager and the ops team. You decide what we build first, what we build simply and what we do not build.

The quality bar

  • What "done" means on the platform: tests, reviews, monitoring, and what we check before a change reaches 1,000 medical staff.

  • Reliability in production. When the dashboard or an onboarding breaks, you own the fix and the reason it does not happen again.

The team

  • The engineering team is growing fast and will organise in squads. You will define how this one works: reviews, documentation, technical decisions.

  • You will work daily with a confirmed engineer (2 to 5 years of experience) who joins the platform team at the same time. Their growth is part of your job.

  • You will take part in hiring the next engineers of the team, and you will help onboard them.

  • You will be one of the most experienced engineers in the company and we will expect you to act like it.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere, backend and frontend (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, a design system written in code.
We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

How we build

  • We use AI seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • For this role we are looking for the senior who frames the work first, sets guardrails and reviews carefully.

  • We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. But the judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • Every change lands in front of more than 1,000 medical staff who use the product all day. We talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the sales team that sells the product.

Who does well here

  • 5+ years building full-stack products in production, mostly in startups or fast growing companies where you had to decide with incomplete information.

  • Strong in TypeScript, backend and frontend. A real eye for interface quality and the discipline to follow a design system.

  • You have turned a manual process into a product before, or you really want to.

  • You had good practices before AI: solid system design, clean refactoring and a good nose for the risks of generated code that nobody tested.

  • You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

What we expect from you

First week

  • Get onboarded on the stack.

  • Ship your first improvement on the dashboard.

First month

  • Own one feature end to end, from the spec with the ops team to production.

  • Write down how the platform should evolve.

First 3 months

  • The first version of the scenario engine is in production.

  • A standard clinic can be onboarded without a developer ticket.

6 to 12 months

  • Most new clinics are live within 7 days.

  • Clinics configure their own rules in the dashboard.

  • The platform team has its own way of working, and you have hired at least one engineer into it.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 1h30 in our office with the engineering team, with live coding without AI and a real conversation about product architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • 70-90K + BSPCE.

  • Hybrid 3 days at the office.

  • Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Azure Engineer

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bei uns kannst du aktiv mitgestalten und echten Mehrwert für Kundschaft und Team schaffen.
  • Top Arbeitsumgebung: Modern ausgestattete Büros, unter anderem im Circle am Flughafen Zürich, im PostParc in Bern und an bester Lage in Basel.


Einführung

Bist du ein erfahrener Azure Engineer und hast du eine Leidenschaft für moderne Cloud-Infrastrukturen im Microsoft Umfeld?

Hast du Lust mit uns die Cloud-Plattformen der Zukunft zu konzipieren und zu betreiben? Übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Anbindung von Kundenumgebungen an die Microsoft Cloud Services? Bist du ein Macher und ein Vollblut-Engineer?


Dann suchen wir dich! Lass dich von der isolutions Experience anstecken und erlebe bei uns ein Team, das sich offen und direkt austauscht, sich gegenseitig unterstützt und herausfordert.


Dafür stehst du am Morgen auf:

  • Du leistest 1st-Level-Support für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden – per Telefon, E-Mail und Fernwartung – und erreichst eine hohe Erstlösungsquote.
  • Du analysierst, löst und dokumentierst Anwenderprobleme strukturiert und nachvollziehbar.
  • Du unterstützt im Microsoft-365-Basissupport: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint und OneDrive.
  • Du übernimmst Identity-Themen für einzelne Anwendende – Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, SSPR sowie Passwort- und Account-Anliegen.
  • Du kümmerst dich um Endpoint-Grundlagen (Intune, Enrollment-Status), verwaltest Zugriffsrechte und weist Lizenzen zu.
  • Du arbeitest nach ITIL-Prozessen in ServiceNow, eskalierst strukturiert ins 2nd Level und bleibst am Ticket, bis es gelöst ist.
  • Du erstellst Dokumentationen und Checklisten und pflegst aktiv unsere Wissensdatenbank.
  • Du arbeitest mit Drittanbietern zusammen und hältst interne Prozesse aktuell.
  • Du übernimmst administrative Aufgaben, erstellst Auswertungen und pflegst unser Dynamics 365.


Wir wünschen uns von dir:

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatiker/in EFZ oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung; eine Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF/FH ist von Vorteil oder bereits geplant.
  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung als Cloud oder Azure Engineer sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Microsoft-Azure-Umfeld mit.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Azure Compute und Storage, Azure Networking, Microsoft Entra ID und RBAC sowie praktische Erfahrung im Backup- und Restore-Betrieb und in Azure Monitor.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) und Git-Workflows und hast bereits anspruchsvolle Azure- und Cloud-Migrationsprojekte in komplexen Umgebungen erfolgreich umgesetzt.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit PowerShell und Azure CLI und setzt Automatisierung und Standardisierung gezielt zur Optimierung von Prozessen und Services ein.
  • Kenntnisse in Azure Policy und Governance, Azure Site Recovery, Cost Management, Microsoft Defender for Cloud sowie Erfahrungen mit Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Azure DevOps Pipelines oder Hybrid-Szenarien sind von Vorteil. Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-500 oder AZ-400 sind ein Plus.

jobs.description:
Legal AI Counsel (Zurich)
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract review. Today we build a holistic platform that changes how legal teams operate from review to negotiation, powered by our Legal Agent. We are looking for the person who makes that value real for customers: in the demo, in onboarding, and inside the AI itself.

When you join Legartis, you don't just take a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and legal experts. We don't chase hype; we build substance.


Your mission

This is not a classic legal role, and not a classic sales or product role. You operate at the intersection of Law, Revenue, and AI, where you are a lever, not a bottleneck: your job is to build the demos, playbooks, and standards that let the whole company scale, and to step into the calls where your expertise closes the gap.

1. Commercial impact. You help win and grow customers. You build and run demos that create a "wow" moment, join high-stakes prospect calls as the legal expert who speaks at eye level with GCs, and run our trials and workshops: onboarding sessions where customers solve their own use cases live, with you coaching. You turn objections into use cases and interest into next steps, and you enable our Sales team to tell the legal story without you in the room. You think of outcomes in terms of trial-to-signature conversion, adoption, expansion.

2. Customer transformation. Once a deal is signed, you make the value real by acting as a strategic sparring partner in onboarding: defining review requirements, tuning playbooks and prompts, and showing legal teams where Legartis delivers the highest ROI. You turn individual learnings into scalable standards and documentation.

3. Making the AI better. You work hands-on with the Legal Agent: prompting, testing, diagnosing where it breaks and why. You feed what you learn from customers back into Product and Engineering (playbook quality, test sets, edge cases) so the product improves with every customer.

4. Internal legal support. You don't just sell the tool; you use it. When necessary, you support Legartis as in-house counsel on contract reviews and specific legal questions.


Your profile

We are honest: people who combine all of this are rare. We hire for aptitude and attitude, assess hands-on in a case study, and train the rest side by side, in real customer work.

1. You can sell the product (key). Not in the cold-calling sense, but in the way a great expert sells: by making the customer succeed in front of their own team. Concretely, this means you can (or want to learn to):

  • Run a live demo with confidence including customized, high-stakes demos and recover gracefully when something doesn't land: pull out a better prompt, adjust on the spot, turn a skeptical question into a stronger result.
  • Coach the customer hands-on. In trials and hackathons, the customer drives and you navigate: you get them to enter their own real legal questions, create the first "wow" moment themselves, and build the habits (saved prompts, reusable workflows) that make them stay.
  • Turn objections into use cases. When a customer says "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves," you respond with a concrete path: a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative. You're straight about limits, because credibility is what closes.
  • Speak at eye level with GCs and legal teams asking sharp discovery questions, translating their friction points into what the product can do, and framing value in their language (ROI, risk, time saved).
  • Always leave with a next step. Trial licenses, a hackathon, a follow-up workshop, a scoped rollout conversation. You instinctively convert interest into momentum, and you remove friction ("we can make that happen") rather than adding process. Ideally you can point to moments where you influenced a deal, a renewal, or an expansion in any prior role.

2. Legal foundation. Solid legal training and hands-on experience with commercial contracts from in-house, law firm, or legal tech. You understand the "why" behind a clause and can teach that logic to an AI and to a customer. A German 2. Staatsexamen is welcome but not required: we explicitly encourage candidates with qualifications from other jurisdictions or non-traditional paths (e.g. law + IT).

3. Hands-on AI builder. You have spent serious time with LLMs, not as a spectator, but pushing them to their limits. You see prompting and evaluation as a craft and enjoy figuring out where AI systems break and how to fix them.

4. Ownership & communication. You can point to things you built, launched, or drove. You are structured enough to run projects with multiple stakeholders, and precise enough to know that a sharp prompt beats a thousand vague instructions. Excellent German and English; other languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, revenue, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • Leverage, not grind. You build the standards, playbooks, and demos that multiply your expertise across the whole company.
  • We invest in you. Structured training on the Legal Agent, side-by-side customer calls, and a clear growth path — we build the capability the market doesn't have yet.
  • True ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
  • Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup, plus apéros, lunches, and hiking trips.


Process

  1. Get to know each other: a chat with our People & Operations Manager.
  2. Deep dive with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI into Legal Engineering at Legartis.
  3. Case study: real tasks at the crossroads of legal thinking, AI prompting, and making the commercial case to a customer.
  4. Meet the team in our Zurich office.
  5. Mutual decision, and we welcome you on board.

Sitting at the intersection of Corporate Communications, Tenable Research, Product Marketing and Revenue Marketing, this leader will transform proprietary research, executive expertise and customer insights into compelling market narratives. Reporting to the Vice President of Corporate Communications, the Director will lead the content marketing team, combining strategic planning with hands-on writing and editorial leadership.

jobs.description:
Head of Growth Marketing

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane, and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable.

Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide. We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io

We are hiring a Head of Growth Marketing to own the Upbound funnel end to end. This role reports directly to the VP of Marketing. This is an AI-first role. We are not looking for someone to bolt AI onto a legacy demand generation playbook and build the growth function around AI-native tools and workflows. You will own campaigns, and the systems across our marketing stack. This is a great opportunity to build and operate a stack and growth function that will grow with the organization and support our enterprise and product led motions.

What you will own

  • Full-funnel growth for the Upbound commercial platform, with Crossplane and Modelplane driving open source top of the funnel.
  • The campaign roadmap and program budget, with regular business reviews alongside marketing and sales leadership.
  • Paid media. You set the channel mix, the targeting, and the efficiency bar against company and sales targets
  • Lifecycle marketing and marketing operations, including the marketing automation platform, attribution model, and funnel reporting.
  • Conversion, organic search, and AI answer visibility across upbound.io, and modelplane.ai
  • The self-serve motion, from signup through activation to paid conversion, in partnership with the product and engineering organization.
  • Build and manage a growth team built over several quarters across
  • Manage and maintain relationships and efficiencies with agencies, and vendors.

How you will evolve the growth function

  • Evaluate, pilot, and adopt AI-native marketing tools. Retire the ones that do not earn their place.
  • Replace manual reporting with AI-assisted analysis so the team spends its time on decisions instead of spreadsheets.
  • Compress the campaign production cycle. Audience research, creative variants, landing pages, and iteration should move in days, not weeks.
  • Build agentic workflows for repeatable work such as list building, enrichment, signal routing, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Set the standard for how AI-assisted work gets reviewed. Speed matters. So does accuracy in a market of technical buyers who will catch a wrong claim immediately.
  • Bring a point of view on what happens to the funnel as buyers research through AI assistants instead of search engines, and get us there first.

You are a good fit if you

  • Have 10+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 3 leading growth, demand generation, or acquisition.
  • Have owned a meaningful program budget and can walk through how you allocated it, what returned, and what you cut.
  • Are still hands-on. You get into the ad platforms, the automation platform, the dashboards, and the data yourself.
  • Have already changed how a marketing team works by introducing AI tools, and can describe honestly what worked and what did not.
  • Are fluent in analytics. You can size an opportunity, design a test, and defend a number in front of the sales team.
  • Have marketed to technical buyers, ideally platform engineers or infrastructure teams.
  • Have built or managed a small team.
  • Work well with autonomy and know when to ask for support.

It is a plus if you

  • Have worked in open source, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure.
  • Have run growth for a sales-led and a self-serve motion at the same company.
  • Have used intent data and account signal tools.
  • Have shipped something yourself with AI. A workflow, a script, an internal tool, an agent.
  • Have contributed to a technical community rather than only marketed to one.

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. Business Development Manager (m/w/d)

Dabei geht es nicht darum, bestehende Prozesse einfach abzuarbeiten. Du strukturierst komplexe Probleme, stellst die richtigen Fragen, entwickelst neue Lösungsansätze und setzt diese hands-on um.

Du kombinierst analytisches Denken, Business Development und kommerzielles Verständnis und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen. Deine Ideen sollen nicht nur auf dem Papier funktionieren – Du bringst sie in die Umsetzung und misst ihren tatsächlichen Impact.

Business Development & Growth

  • Du entwickelst neue Ansätze, um die Nutzung unserer Finanzierungslösung bei Partnern zu steigern.

  • Du denkst über einzelne Partner hinaus und entwickelst Lösungen, die auf größere Teile unseres Partnernetzwerks übertragbar sind.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Umsetzung Deiner Ideen und misst deren Erfolg.

Analytics & Problem Solving

  • Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund und fragst Dich nicht nur „Was passiert?“, sondern vor allem „Warum passiert es?“ und „Was können wir verändern?“

  • Du übersetzt Analysen in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen.

  • Du erkennst Zusammenhänge und Muster und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungsansätze.

  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Möglichkeiten, unser Partnergeschäft effizienter und skalierbarer zu machen.

  • Du kannst zwischen Detailtiefe und strategischer Perspektive wechseln.

Partner & Commercial Ownership

  • Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität und bist bereit, selbst in die Umsetzung zu gehen.

Zusammenarbeit & Aufbau

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen.

  • Du bringst Deine Erkenntnisse in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und unseres Partnerangebots ein.

  • Du hilfst dabei, Best Practices und skalierbare Strukturen aufzubauen.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für neue Themen und treibst sie eigenständig von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Du wartest nicht darauf, dass für jedes Problem bereits ein Prozess existiert.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast erste Berufserfahrung in Business Development, Consulting, Strategy, Sales, Key Account Management, Commercial Operations oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.

  • Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte analytische und unternehmerische Denkweise.

  • Du hast Spaß daran, komplexe Probleme zu strukturieren und aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.

  • Du denkst proaktiv, erkennst Chancen und möchtest Dinge selbst voranbringen.

  • Du hast eine Growth-Mentalität und möchtest nicht nur bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern neue Lösungen entwickeln.

  • Du hast ein gutes kommerzielles Verständnis und kannst Dich in Kunden- und Partnerperspektiven hineinversetzen.

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau, da Du mit Partnern aus ganz Deutschland kommunizierst und unterschiedliche regionale Akzente sicher verstehen musst.

Was Dich bei EFS erwartet

Wir sind hey contact heroes, ein Kundenservice-Dienstleister aus dem Herzen von Hamburg, im Zentrum der HafenCity. Seit 2021 betreuen wir für Marken wie Telefónica, 1&1, Universal Music, Check24, Hamburg Wasser und enviaM deren Kundinnen und Kunden am Telefon, per Mail und im Chat. Mehr als 500 Teammitglieder arbeiten bei uns europaweit remote, und in den letzten Jahren sind wir jedes Jahr um 8 bis 10 Prozent gewachsen.

Bei uns entstehen jeden Tag sehr viele Daten: Anrufvolumen, Bearbeitungszeiten, Qualitätswerte, Schichtpläne, Umsätze pro Projekt. Damit wir daraus noch mehr machen, suchen wir jemanden, der Zahlen liebt und gleichzeitig Spaß daran hat, Dinge zu bauen. Die Stelle ist zu 100 % remote und kann von überall in Europa besetzt werden.

Aufgaben

Du wertest unsere Daten aus allen Projekten aus und machst daraus Reports und Dashboards, mit denen Geschäftsführung, Projektmanagement und Kunden wirklich arbeiten können. Du richtest Datenbanken ein, pflegst sie und sorgst dafür, dass Daten aus Telefonie-, Ticket- und CRM-Systemen sauber zusammenlaufen. Du liest Daten über Schnittstellen und Exporte aus, bereinigst sie und bringst sie in eine Struktur, auf die man sich verlassen kann.

Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit ist Automatisierung. Du baust Workflows und automatisierte Prozesse, zum Beispiel mit n8n, Make oder eigenen Skripten, damit wiederkehrende Auswertungen, Datenabgleiche und Meldungen ohne Handarbeit laufen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Projektleitungen und unserer IT zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, was sich noch einfacher und schneller lösen lässt.

Qualifikation

Du hast ein tiefes Zahlenverständnis und erkennst schnell, ob eine Kennzahl stimmt oder ob etwas nicht passt. SQL beherrschst du sicher, und du hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken wie MySQL, PostgreSQL oder MS SQL. Mit gängigen Datenformaten wie CSV, JSON, XML und Excel gehst du routiniert um, und REST-Schnittstellen sind für dich nichts Neues.

Du kannst programmieren, idealerweise in Python oder JavaScript, und hast schon Workflows oder Automatisierungen gebaut, gern mit Tools wie n8n, Make oder Zapier. Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Power BI, Looker Studio oder Metabase ist ein Plus. Ob du ein Studium in Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Statistik hast oder dir das Wissen in der Praxis angeeignet hast, ist uns nicht so wichtig. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst.

Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert, dokumentierst sauber und erklärst auch komplexe Zusammenhänge so, dass sie jeder versteht. Deutsch sprichst du auf muttersprachlichem Niveau oder mindestens auf C1/C2, gutes Englisch rundet dein Profil ab.

Benefits

Du arbeitest zu 100 % remote, egal ob du in Deutschland, Spanien, Polen oder einem anderen europäischen Land lebst. Du bekommst spannende Daten aus vielen unterschiedlichen Kundenprojekten und viel Gestaltungsspielraum, weil du bei uns Strukturen mit aufbaust statt nur zu verwalten. Unsere Wege sind kurz, Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Dazu kommt ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, und ein Arbeitgeber, der wächst.

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich direkt hier über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf und gern ein paar Sätzen oder Beispielen dazu, welche Auswertungen oder Automatisierungen du schon gebaut hast. Alles Weitere zu Vertragsform, Stundenumfang und Vergütung besprechen wir gemeinsam im ersten Gespräch. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Data Analyst & Automation Engineer (m/w/d) | 100 % remote

Wir sind hey contact heroes, ein Kundenservice-Dienstleister aus dem Herzen von Hamburg, im Zentrum der HafenCity. Seit 2021 betreuen wir für Marken wie Telefónica, 1&1, Universal Music, Check24, Hamburg Wasser und enviaM deren Kundinnen und Kunden am Telefon, per Mail und im Chat. Mehr als 500 Teammitglieder arbeiten bei uns europaweit remote, und in den letzten Jahren sind wir jedes Jahr um 8 bis 10 Prozent gewachsen.

Bei uns entstehen jeden Tag sehr viele Daten: Anrufvolumen, Bearbeitungszeiten, Qualitätswerte, Schichtpläne, Umsätze pro Projekt. Damit wir daraus noch mehr machen, suchen wir jemanden, der Zahlen liebt und gleichzeitig Spaß daran hat, Dinge zu bauen. Die Stelle ist zu 100 % remote und kann von überall in Europa besetzt werden.

Aufgaben

Du wertest unsere Daten aus allen Projekten aus und machst daraus Reports und Dashboards, mit denen Geschäftsführung, Projektmanagement und Kunden wirklich arbeiten können. Du richtest Datenbanken ein, pflegst sie und sorgst dafür, dass Daten aus Telefonie-, Ticket- und CRM-Systemen sauber zusammenlaufen. Du liest Daten über Schnittstellen und Exporte aus, bereinigst sie und bringst sie in eine Struktur, auf die man sich verlassen kann.

Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit ist Automatisierung. Du baust Workflows und automatisierte Prozesse, zum Beispiel mit n8n, Make oder eigenen Skripten, damit wiederkehrende Auswertungen, Datenabgleiche und Meldungen ohne Handarbeit laufen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Projektleitungen und unserer IT zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, was sich noch einfacher und schneller lösen lässt.

Qualifikation

Du hast ein tiefes Zahlenverständnis und erkennst schnell, ob eine Kennzahl stimmt oder ob etwas nicht passt. SQL beherrschst du sicher, und du hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken wie MySQL, PostgreSQL oder MS SQL. Mit gängigen Datenformaten wie CSV, JSON, XML und Excel gehst du routiniert um, und REST-Schnittstellen sind für dich nichts Neues.

Du kannst programmieren, idealerweise in Python oder JavaScript, und hast schon Workflows oder Automatisierungen gebaut, gern mit Tools wie n8n, Make oder Zapier. Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Power BI, Looker Studio oder Metabase ist ein Plus. Ob du ein Studium in Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Statistik hast oder dir das Wissen in der Praxis angeeignet hast, ist uns nicht so wichtig. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst.

Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert, dokumentierst sauber und erklärst auch komplexe Zusammenhänge so, dass sie jeder versteht. Deutsch sprichst du auf muttersprachlichem Niveau oder mindestens auf C1/C2, gutes Englisch rundet dein Profil ab.

Benefits

Du arbeitest zu 100 % remote, egal ob du in Deutschland, Spanien, Polen oder einem anderen europäischen Land lebst. Du bekommst spannende Daten aus vielen unterschiedlichen Kundenprojekten und viel Gestaltungsspielraum, weil du bei uns Strukturen mit aufbaust statt nur zu verwalten. Unsere Wege sind kurz, Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Dazu kommt ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, und ein Arbeitgeber, der wächst.

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich direkt hier über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf und gern ein paar Sätzen oder Beispielen dazu, welche Auswertungen oder Automatisierungen du schon gebaut hast. Alles Weitere zu Vertragsform, Stundenumfang und Vergütung besprechen wir gemeinsam im ersten Gespräch. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.description:
Founding Account Manager, EMEA

Founding Account Manager, EMEA

The Role

Geordie helps enterprises govern their AI agents safely, and our customer base is growing quickly. We're hiring our founding Account Manager for EMEA to look after those customers and help them get the most out of Geordie.

This is an important hire for us. You'll be the first person in EMEA focused entirely on existing customers, looking after our first 50 or so customers in the region plus our strategic accounts. Our US Account Manager has already put much of our customer process in place. You'll adapt it for EMEA and keep improving how we onboard, support, grow, and renew customers.

When a customer runs into a problem, you'll dig into the technical detail yourself and work with our Technical Account Managers, Support, and Engineering teams until it's fixed.

The role is also commercial. You'll own renewals and carry a renewal number, and you'll work with our Account Executives on upsell and cross-sell.

We use AI agents in our day-to-day work, including tools like Claude Cowork, and we'd expect you to as well. If that doesn't interest you, this probably isn't the right role.

What You'll Do

Own the Customer Relationship — Be the main day-to-day contact for our first 50 or so EMEA customers and our strategic accounts. Run bi-weekly check-ins and Executive Business Reviews. Know each customer well: what they're trying to achieve with AI agents, who the key people are, and where Geordie is helping.

Lead Onboarding and Implementation — Run onboarding and implementation for new customers. Agree milestones with them, hold them to those milestones, and get them up and running quickly.

Evolve the Customer Motion — Take the processes our US team has built, adapt them for EMEA, and improve them as we learn. Add to our playbooks and health metrics.

Solve Problems Hands-On — Learn the Geordie platform well enough to troubleshoot issues yourself. When something needs Support, a Technical Account Manager, or Engineering, stay on it until the customer's problem is solved.

Own Renewals — Carry a renewal number and hit it. Start renewal conversations early, spot at-risk accounts in advance, and put a plan in place for each one.

Drive Expansion — Work with our Account Executives on upsell and cross-sell. Look for opportunities in new teams, use cases, and products, and lead the conversations where you know the customer best.

Turn Customers into Advocates — Get happy customers to speak up for Geordie, whether that's a reference call, an introduction to a prospect, a review, a testimonial, a case study, or a public post.

Be the Voice of the Customer — Pass what you hear from customers to Product and Engineering, clearly and regularly, so it shapes what we build next.

Collaborate Across the Company — Work closely with Sales, Technical Account Managers, Support, Product, and Development. Make handoffs smooth so customers never have to repeat themselves.

CRM Discipline — Keep Attio up to date with account health, renewal dates, expansion opportunities, and next steps.

Forecasting — Give accurate renewal and expansion forecasts, including which accounts are at risk and what you're doing about it.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who builds customer trust quickly, fixes problems themselves where they can, and takes responsibility for renewals and growth.

You're a builder. We're early, so plenty of things aren't figured out yet. You like setting up and improving processes, and you're comfortable working without a finished playbook.

You're technical. You don't need to be an engineer, but you take the time to understand the product properly. When a customer has a problem, you try to fix it yourself first.

You're commercial. You're comfortable owning a renewal number, negotiating renewals, and working with our AEs on expansion. You know that happy customers and revenue are closely linked.

You're obsessed with your customers. You want your customers to succeed, you think ahead about what they'll need, and you speak up for them inside Geordie.

You work well with others. You build good relationships across Sales, Technical Account Management, Support, and Development, and you know how to get the right people involved when a customer needs help.

You're organised. You update Attio as you go, so anyone can open an account and see where things stand. Your renewal forecasts hold up, and you can explain the plan for every account you own.

You use AI in your work. You already use AI tools, including agents, day to day, and you're keen to use more.

You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make decisions without having every answer, and you change course when you need to.

Requirements

  • 5–7 years of experience in account management, customer success, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity.

  • Proven track record of owning and delivering a renewal number, with strong gross and net retention results.

  • Experience driving or supporting upsell and cross-sell motions in partnership with sales teams.

  • Experience managing relationships with enterprise customers across multiple stakeholders, from practitioners to senior leadership.

  • Technical aptitude and a hands-on approach to troubleshooting complex products.

  • Experience building or significantly improving customer processes, playbooks, or functions.

  • Disciplined about keeping CRM data accurate and current.

  • A track record of working well across sales, support, technical, and product teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, and the confidence to run Executive Business Reviews with senior stakeholders.

  • Based in or able to commute to London regularly; willingness to travel within Europe as needed.

Nice to Haves

  • Fluency in one or more European languages in addition to English (e.g. French, German, Spanish, Dutch, Italian, or Nordic languages).

  • Experience working with security or AI/ML tooling customers.

  • Prior experience as an early or founding customer hire at a high-growth Series A–B SaaS company.

  • An existing network of enterprise security and AI leaders in the UK and Europe.

Why This Role

Enterprises are adopting AI agents quickly, and they need a way to govern them safely. That's what Geordie does. Keeping our customers successful is how we grow, so this role matters a lot to us. As our first Account Manager in EMEA, you'll have a real say in how we work with customers, what we build next, and the culture of the team.

Our Values

Solve What Matters — We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate — We favour momentum over perfection: testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable — We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

A Platform for Your Best Work — We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript) - Integrations

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

The problem you will solve

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. Nobody else has managed to build this. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is also the team with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

The long term vision is simple: the agent becomes the action layer between patients and everything the front desk used to do by hand. The integrations are the road to get there. You would be building that road.

What you will own

  • The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that can handle the rules of each medical centre and where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

  • Speed and reliability at more than 1 million calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You will decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

  • The hard integrations that nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

  • How the team works. Engineering team is growing fast and will organise in squads. You will define how this one works: reviews, documentation, technical decisions. You will be one of the most experienced engineers in the company and we will expect you to act like it.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors.
We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

How we build

  • We use AI seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • For this role we are looking a the senior who frames the work first, sets guardrails and reviews carefully.

  • We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. But the judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • We talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the support team that hears when something breaks.

What we expect from you

First week

  • Get onboarded on the stack.

  • Ship your first fix on a live integration.

First month

  • Own one integration end to end, from the software vendor to production.

  • Write down how our booking layer should evolve.

First 3 months

  • The unified booking layer in TypeScript is the standard.

  • Adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

  • We detect a booking failure in any clinic within 24 hours.

6 to 12 months

  • Our first US integrations run in production.

  • The integrations team has its own way of working, and you have hired at least one engineer into it.

Who does well here

  • 4+ years building backend systems in production, mostly in startups or fast growing companies where you had to decide with incomplete information.

  • Strong in TypeScript and Node. Or a strong backend engineer in Go, Python or Java who is clearly ready to become strong in TypeScript.

  • You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world.

  • You had good practices before AI: strong system, clean refactoring and a good nose for the risks of generated code that nobody tested.

  • You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

Process: 4 steps

  1. 45 min with Nans, Talent.

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 1h30 in our office with the engineering team, with live coding without AI and a real conversation about architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • 70-90K + BSPCE.

  • Hybrid 3 days at the office.

  • Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist

Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the Role.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join Zilch’s Risk team, with a focus on developing and optimising advanced models in the Risk space, primarily across credit risk, with additional focus on collections optimisation and fraud detection. You will leverage diverse data sources to support key areas across the business, building production-grade models and decisioning solutions that improve risk outcomes, customer experience, and operational efficiency. This role will involve close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, risk strategy, credit, collections, fraud, and other data scientists, to ensure data-driven insights are successfully integrated into product strategies, risk decisioning, and business growth initiatives.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong applied machine learning with modern ML Ops practices. We are looking for a data scientist who can take models from exploration through to production, monitoring, and iteration.

Key Responsibilities.

  • Work with large and complex datasets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using various analytical and statistical approaches.

  • Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, and the presentation of data to develop strategies for our products that serve millions of customers and thousands of merchants.

  • Build, validate, deploy, and monitor robust, scalable machine learning models and model pipelines across the risk lifecycle, including onboarding, affordability, life-time value, credit/default risk, in-life risk, collections, and fraud.

  • Present complex data science findings and methodologies to senior stakeholders clearly and concisely.

  • Apply machine learning methods to solve risk and product-related business problems and enhance our decision-making processes.

  • Contribute to the team’s coding efforts, ensuring best practices in version control, testing, CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, methodologies, workflows, and tooling.

  • Conduct A/B testing, champion/challenger testing, and experimental analyses to evaluate new features, risk strategies, model changes, and product changes.

  • Partner closely with engineering and platform teams to operationalise models, automate workflows, and improve model reliability in production.

What We're Looking For.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a data scientist, with a focus on building and deploying models to enhance the customer product experience, risk decisioning, and business outcomes, ideally within credit risk, collections, fraud, financial services, lending, payments, or another decision-intensive domain.

  • Proficiency in SQL, Python and core data science and machine learning libraries, such as NumPy, Pandas and Scikit-Learn.

  • Strong practical experience with machine learning model development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production environments, including cloud-based model training, archiving, serving, endpoint deployment, and tools such as Amazon SageMaker or similar.

  • Experience communicating complex ideas to non-technical audiences and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of machine learning methods, their application in real-world scenarios and a keen awareness of their limitations.

  • A strong engineering mindset, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-ready code, use version control systems such as Git, and collaborate effectively in a multi-developer environment.

  • A results-driven approach, with the ability to quickly iterate and improve models in production.

  • Knowledge of AI safety considerations, such as bias detection, privacy management, and handling personally identifiable information (PII).

  • Familiarity with software development best practices and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, such as GitHub Actions.

  • Experience using DBT for data modelling and Looker for BI reporting.

  • An interest in staying up to date with evolving technologies and applying them to enhance business outcomes.

Nice to Have.

The following are bonuses rather than strict requirements. We do not expect candidates to have all of them:

  • Prior experience in credit risk modelling, collections optimisation, fraud detection, or risk strategy.

  • Familiarity with risk model governance, explainability, fairness, affordability, or regulatory considerations in financial services.

  • Experience with decision science, automated decisioning systems, decision engines, or risk strategy implementation.

  • Experience applying neural networks or deep learning approaches to practical risk, fraud, or decisioning problems.

Head of Growth Marketing

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

You will own customer acquisition across digital growth surfaces, including web, SEO, paid media, OOH, creator, and emerging channels such as Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), while partnering closely with Product to drive activation, conversion, and monetization.

You will also lead our Demand Generation team, owning performance marketing execution and digital channel strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a growth-minded marketer who thrives in experimentation, understands unit economics, and knows how to turn traffic into revenue.

Growth & Demand Generation Leadership

Self-Serve & Product-Led Growth

Website & Digital Growth Surfaces

Product, Brand & Content Strategy

• Collaborate on product launches, crafting compelling messaging and providing materials to support Sales and partners

• Drive Flex’s narrative through high-impact content across website copy, campaigns, organic, paid, email, press, and referral channels

What You Bring

• 6–10+ years of experience in growth, digital, or performance marketing, ideally in FinTech or a B2B SaaS environment

• 3+ years of people management experience, with a track record of building and mentoring high-performing teams

• Proven success scaling organizations from $50M → $100M → $200M + ARR

• Fluency in sales-led acquisition, intent-based targeting, personalization, trigger-based messaging, and predictive analytics

• Strong strategic instincts grounded in research, data, and customer insights across campaigns, content, events, organic, paid, affiliate, and beyond

• A collaborative, human-first leader with strong values, empathy, and a bias toward action

Compensation

Generous compensation package determined based on experience, geography, and impact. Annual earnings derived from a combination of base, stock, and bonus from achieving targets.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with sales, product, engineering, and support teams to ensure smooth handoffs, escalate critical issues, and drive customer success across the organization.

This role sits at the intersection of customer success, solution strategy, and technical enablement, supporting long-term growth, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. TAMs own the complete post-sales customer lifecycle, from initial implementation and onboarding through ongoing managed services, strategic expansion opportunities, and driving meaningful impact on renewal outcomes across their book of business. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Support to align efforts and ensure each customer’s success story is long-term, scalable, and impactful.
